jobs.title: Senior Account Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

At Ogilvy Health, we work with ambitious healthcare brands to create work that makes a meaningful difference.

We’re looking for a Senior Account Manager to join us, working on an exciting global respiratory account. This is a brilliant opportunity for someone ready for real ownership. You’ll have the autonomy to run the account day to day, build a strong relationship with the client and play a leading role in where the partnership goes next.

You’ll be joining a supportive team, but there’s plenty of space to make the account your own. With a strong pipeline of work ahead and a growing client relationship, you’ll have genuine visibility and the opportunity to make an impact.

You’ll gain further global experience, work across campaign launches and major congress activity, and have a senior team around you when you need it, while still being trusted to lead.

If you’re a Senior Account Manager looking for a role where you can step up, have a voice and genuinely make an account your own, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

You’ll take the lead on the day-to-day running of the account, working closely with the client and wider Ogilvy team to keep everything moving in the right direction.

There’s a great mix of work to get involved in, from taking an established US campaign and helping bring it to global markets, to developing market toolkits, promotional materials and supporting major congress activity.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading the day-to-day client relationship and becoming a trusted partner
  • Taking ownership of the account and keeping priorities, projects and teams moving
  • Leading global campaign work, including adapting and rolling out campaign materials across markets
  • Overseeing the development of promotional materials and communications
  • Working closely with strategy, creative, medical and project management teams
  • Playing a leading role in major congress activity
  • Spotting opportunities to strengthen and grow the client relationship
  • Supporting and developing more junior members of the account team
  • Bringing confidence, good judgement and a collaborative approach to everything you do

What You’ll Need

You’ll already have good experience gained at the Account Manager level within a healthcare communications agency, ideally working with prescription

jobs.title: HR Senior Manager Compensation & Systems
jobs.description:
Host Broadcast Services (HBS) is a leading, independent host broadcast specialist, dedicated to helping international sports federations, organising committees, and rights holders deliver their events to a global audience. We provide world-class broadcast solutions for some of the world’s biggest sporting events, including the prestigious FIFA World Cup™, ensuring broadcasters worldwide can offer fans a unique and engaging viewing experience.

✨ HR Senior Manager Compensation & Systems – France

HBS is looking for an experienced Compensation & Systems Manager to lead the development and delivery of our global reward, benefits and HR systems strategy across an international organisation operating in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
In a Nutshell

As an Automation Engineer (m/f/d), you’ll work in our soon to open Fulfilment Center in Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) with the latest intralogistics systems from top brands like Apollo, Qimarox, and Regal Rexnord. You’ll be responsible for keeping our Material Handling Equipment running at peak performance, solving malfunctions independently, and implementing improvements. Your insight and initiative are valued, and you’ll coach junior colleagues to elevate the team, ensuring tens of thousands of orders reach families on time every day. During your shift, you take full responsibility for the service and maintenance of our systems.

The tricks of the trade

  • Troubleshooting malfunctions: You detect and resolve both electrical and mechanical issues in technical systems, working closely with our operational supervisors.
  • Collaboration with suppliers: For complex problems, you work directly with machine suppliers to find solutions.
  • Analysis and improvement: You analyze malfunctions, prevent recurrence, and implement structural improvements.
  • Preventive maintenance: You perform scheduled preventive maintenance to ensure maximum system availability.

About you

  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g., mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, mechatronics, automation, etc.)
  • You have 7+ years of experience in a technical, automation or maintenance role
  • You have hands-on knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, including measurement and camera systems
  • You have been working with software tools such as CMMS and/or ICS/SCADA tools
  • You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating in a team
  • At the same time, you are independent, take initiative, and solve problems in a goal-oriented way
  • You're fluent in English, ideally also in German

What you can look forward to

  • Smart Commute: Choose the way you move. You will get a company car (with private use) and can make use of our “Lease-a-Bike” program.
  • Time to recharge: With 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 40-hour workweek in a shift system), you can strike the perfect balance between work and leisure.
  • Fuel for Winners: Enjoy fresh, free breakfasts and lunches every day in our Fulfilment Center, along with all the snacks and fruit you need to stay fueled.

jobs.title: Senior Program & Partnerships Manager - Autonomous Vehicle
jobs.description:
Location: London, Barcelona or Berlin!

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The autonomous transition is a transformational opportunity for Lyft. Our strategy focuses on becoming the preferred marketplace, fleet, and operational partner for the world's best Autonomous Vehicle (AV) providers. As AV services begin launching across Europe, the programs that govern our partnerships, from pre-launch planning through ongoing operations, become a critical foundation for sustainable growth. This role sits at the center of that work, owning the end-to-end management of our autonomous partnership programs and serving as the primary face of Lyft to our external partners.

You have experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with external partners or customers. You are a skilled communicator who can represent Lyft externally with credibility and care, while bringing together a wide range of internal teams. You enjoy combining strategic relationship management with hands-on operational rigor, and you know how to stay close to the details without losing sight of the bigger picture. You’re curious, proactive and comfortable working in a new space where processes are still being built.

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:

  • Own program management end-to-end, from launch planning through ongoing operations, including creating launch plans, driving internal alignment on milestones and deliverables, managing workstream trackers, and ensuring quality of deliverables
  • Serve as the primary external point of contact for partners, leading regular syncs, managing day-to-day communications, and building the trusted relationships needed to navigate complex programs and surface issues proactively over time
  • Act as the central hub across cross-functional internal teams supporting the program; drive alignment on priorities and decisions, escalate issues with the right context, and be accountable for resolution
  • Monitor program health and performance on a regular cadence; lead structured deep dives on customer experience, operational quality, and other key areas; present findings and share data and insights internally and with partners
  • Drive program optimization and manage the joint roadmap with partners, own the project intake process, gather requirements and impact sizing from partners, coordinate prioritization across internal teams, and ensure execution against agreed commitments
  • Identify and address gaps in processes, partner experience, or operational execution, proactively flagging risks and driving continuous improvement across the program lifecycle

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril’s Maritime Division has assembled a diverse team of experts in software, robotics, artificial intelligence, sensor fusion, and data analysis to create software and hardware solutions that radically evolve the capabilities of our customers. We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

Set up our standards and processes for electrical systems engineering, including the choice of E-CAD tooling.

Degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, vehicle electronics or a comparable field.

3+ years of experience in Bordnetz or wire harness development, e.g., in automotive, commercial vehicles, rail, aerospace or machine building. Robotics experience is not required.

Proven hands-on experience with grounding, shielding and EMC design, ideally including EMC testing.

jobs.title: Technical Pre - Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

At RobCo, we automate the ordinary, so humans can do the extraordinary. To achieve this, we are looking for an ambitious (Senior) Robotic Sales Engineer (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as leading provider of automation solutions.

Your mission

As a Robotic Sales Engineer (RSE), you are RobCo’s technical face to the customer and the technical lead on every deal you own, from the first customer call to a handover-ready solution. You work as a team with our Account Executives, and every technical question on the deal runs through you. You carry a quota together with your AE, and you win deals as a team.  Your job is to understand the customer’s process better than anyone else in the room, decide early what is feasible and what is not, and turn a real production problem into a clear, qualified automation case. You recommend the right automation approach and hand it over to our Solutions Development team without late surprises.  You work where modular robotics, software and AI come together, and you help bring physical AI from the lab into real production. You show customers what robots that perceive, learn and adapt can do in their plant today. You have direct access to the engineers, product managers and data behind our robots, and you help shape what we build next.

What you will do

Qualify  – Join discovery calls and site visits with your AE. Assess use cases early for technical fit, business value and risk, and say no when a deal does not fit.

Run requirement workshops  – Lead structured on-site workshops with production, engineering and operations teams. Capture parts, processes, cycle times, layout, interfaces, safety and acceptance criteria.

Check feasibility  – Make the first technical call on reach, payload, cycle time, gripping and vision. Use quick layouts, simulations and tests to back it up, and pull in Product or Solutions Development where needed.

Drive the concept  – Turn workshop results into clear requirements and recommend the right automation approach. You own the collaboration with Solutions Development and Product until a complete, buildable concept is in place.

Be the technical face to the customer  – Explain our robots and solutions to plant managers, engineers and executives in plain language. Run demos and support business cases and RaaS pricing inputs.

Close the loop  – Feed field insights back to Product, so what customers need shapes what we build.

What you bring

3+ years where automation meets the customer: technical pre-sales, application engineering or automation projects

You want to be measured by results: you share a quota with your AE and push deals over the line

jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.  Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.  We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.  We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.  Where we are today:

Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

$90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The role

You build a new business line at Andercore from zero. You win the first customers yourself, you build the sales and service system behind them, and you own the number. No playbook, no handover. The CEO is your direct counterpart.  We have built this before in one category. You do it again for the next one.

What you own

First customers: you find them, call them, close them. Your own pipeline from day one.

Sales system: segmentation, pricing logic, offer process, CRM discipline, reporting. Built by you, documented, then handed to a team.

Service system: onboarding, delivery follow-up, claims, repeat orders. The customer experience is yours until it runs without you.

Supplier side: you work with Procurement on sourcing and price for your category.

Team: your first hires, once the system works.

Targets

First 90 days: the first customers won.

First 12 months: a category that stands on its own, with a documented sales and service system.

jobs.description:
Design and build the global network that connects Radiant’s data centres, customers and future regions.

At a glance

Team:  Infrastructure Delivery, Office of the CTO
 Reports to:  Infrastructure Delivery lead
 Location:  UK based, with travel to sites and industry events
 Work model:  Hybrid

Who we are

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale, powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments.  Our Infrastructure Delivery team designs and builds the systems that connect our sites and bring new capacity online. The backbone is a critical part of that work as Radiant expands across regions.

The opportunity

You will own the architecture of Radiant’s global backbone, from the first design decision through build, testing and handover. It will connect our data centres, new developments, cloud and customer interconnects, while meeting demanding requirements for resilience, capacity and data sovereignty.  You will be the design authority for the backbone, working hands-on with a small architecture team, delivery partners, vendors and carriers. Infrastructure Operations will run the network after go-live, so you will bring them into decisions early and give them a network they can operate confidently.

What you’ll do

Define the backbone architecture and roadmap, including routing, traffic engineering, site connectivity, transit, peering and private interconnects.

Turn customer, capacity and sovereignty requirements into designs that can be built and operated. Work with cluster network, infrastructure, storage, security and data centre teams to resolve trade-offs.

Produce high-level and low-level designs, bills of materials, test plans and acceptance criteria. Lead design reviews and approve the technical design before build and handover.

Evaluate routing and optical platforms, carriers and proposed designs. Contribute technical requirements and assessments to procurement processes while Procurement owns commercial terms.

Establish standards for network automation, a source of truth and streaming telemetry. Validate designs in the lab, investigate complex backbone faults and improve the architecture as the network grows.

Represent Radiant in technical discussions with customers, vendors and the wider network community, including at relevant industry events.

What you’ll bring

You have owned a multi-site backbone from design through production, including delivery across more than one country. You bring around ten years in network engineering, with substantial carrier, service provider or hyperscale backbone experience.

You have deep practical knowledge of BGP, an interior routing protocol such as IS-IS or OSPF, MPLS and segment routing. You can design internet edges, peering, data centre interconnects and resilient paths.

About Us

We’re a fast-growing GPU-as-a-Service provider, delivering scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure purpose-built for AI and HPC workloads. Operating across global data centres, we run mission-critical environments where uptime, throughput, and ultra-low latency are non-negotiable.

Role Overview

We are looking for a senior Infrastructure Site Reliability Engineer with deep experience operating large-scale distributed systems and recent hands-on expertise in high-performance computing (HPC) and AI infrastructure. This is an operations-first SRE role, working in a 24/7/365 on-call environment, responsible for ensuring reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of mission-critical infrastructure. This role sits within a cross-functional organisation spanning network engineering, infrastructure SRE, Platform SRE, infrastructure tooling engineers (software) and data centre operations.  The ideal candidate has progressed through large-scale, globally distributed or multi-site infrastructure environments and has more recently specialised in GPU-accelerated HPC systems. This role provides exposure to the  latest high-density AI compute platforms , including next-generation GPU infrastructure at significant scale. You will bring strong breadth across bare metal, networking, storage, virtualisation, and orchestration, alongside deep HPC experience including NVIDIA GPU ecosystems, RDMA networking (RoCE and InfiniBand), and performance validation and benchmarking. Strong Linux and distributed systems expertise is essential.  Alongside operational ownership, this is a deeply technical Infrastructure SRE role centred on advanced operational troubleshooting and performance evaluation across large-scale HPC systems. You will investigate complex, cross-layer issues spanning GPU compute, networking, storage, and orchestration, building a clear understanding of system behaviour under real production AI and HPC workloads.  A key responsibility is performance evaluation, testing, and operational acceptance of new HPC environments, ensuring platforms meet defined reliability, scalability, and performance expectations before entering production. You will work across hardware, network, and software layers to validate readiness of high-density GPU infrastructure and support safe, predictable deployment at scale.  You will also play a central role in continuous service improvement (CSI)—reducing operational toil, increasing automation, and improving reliability, consistency, and operational efficiency across the platform. This includes strengthening observability, refining operational workflows, and eliminating repetitive or failure-prone processes.  Over time, you will help shape future infrastructure design and deployment approaches, feeding operational insight back into infrastructure engineering decisions and ensuring production learnings directly influence next-generation HPC platform evolution.

jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius Token Factory is looking for scientists who can turn frontier LLM and VLM inference bottlenecks into research questions, conduct rigorous experiments, and translate their findings into production capabilities. You will own focused research and optimization projects, write strong code, and produce prototypes, publications, and technical artifacts that engineers can build on.

Your research will span quantization, distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization, and model/runtime co-optimization, alongside inference engines and distributed inference architectures. You will investigate how these approaches interact, evaluate their trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, memory footprint, and cost per token, and work with engineering teams to bring promising results into production.

Your responsibilities

  • Lead research projects in efficient LLM and VLM inference, from hypotheses and experiments through ablations, prototypes, and production handoff.
  • Develop and evaluate methods spanning quantization, quantization-aware training (QAT), distillation, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, KV-cache compression, long-context inference, MoE routing, and model/runtime co-optimization.
  • Build prototypes using PyTorch, Triton, CUDA-adjacent tooling, or inference-serving frameworks, and collaborate with MLEs and platform engineers to turn them into production components.
  • Research LLM request routing and scheduling strategies, including cache-aware load balancing and prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD). Evaluate how queueing, KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and prefill/decode capacity allocation affect latency, throughput, and serving cost.
  • Investigate multi-node inference for dense and mixture-of-experts models, including wide expert parallelism (WideEP). Study expert placement, load imbalance, and computation/communication trade-offs, and use the findings to guide model and system architecture choices.
  • Develop rigorous evaluations covering quality, latency, throughput, numerical stability, memory footprint, tail

jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. The Role

Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Almost every Nebius service runs on servers within our domain. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible.

We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet.

As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation.
You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Design, build, and operate services for netboot, provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning.
  • Lead technical initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation and production operation.
  • Help shape the technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integration, and long-term engineering work.
  • Define meaningful reliability indicators and service level objectives, using them to guide engineering priorities.
  • Reduce operational toil by turning recurring failures and manual procedures into reliable automation.
  • Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews.
  • Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness.

We operate across data centers worldwide, running YTsaurus in dedicated Kubernetes clusters with Kubernetes operators and supporting services written primarily in Go. We maintain our own Nebius distribution, develop functionality across the core and platform services, and contribute upstream where it makes sense. This gives us the ability to take improvements from design through implementation to production.

  • AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Grafana

jobs.description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.  Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

This is a full-time, 12-month program at our Berlin HQ for people who want to  understand  AI rather than just use it.  It begins where our product meets the real world: customer support. Many support tickets are a small puzzle about how large language models and cloud software behave in production. Why did the same prompt give two different answers? Why did a long document get cut off? Why is one model fast today and slow tomorrow? Why did an agent call the wrong tool? Why did an API integration time out? You will be the person who works out what is actually going on and explains it clearly.  For most of your first year, the support queue is your home base and your classroom. Few jobs expose you to as many real AI systems, real enterprise environments, and real failure modes, every single day.  The purpose of the year: by month twelve, you should understand our platform and operations deeply, from the chat interface down to the models and infrastructure behind it. A Langdock business team should want to hire you permanently, and you should have found the work that energizes you most.

What You Will Learn to Understand

Customers ask the questions that the rest of the world is still figuring out. To answer them, you will build real intuition for:

How LLMs actually behave : tokens and context windows, sampling and non-determinism, hallucinations, prompt sensitivity, system prompts, and why models from different providers react differently to the same input.

Agents, tools, and retrieval : how agents plan and call tools, how knowledge bases and document search feed context to a model, and where these chains tend to break.

Cloud software in production : APIs, authentication and SSO, rate limits, latency, integrations, multi-tenant enterprise setups, data residency, and access control.

Inference and compute : what happens when a request hits a model, why throughput, latency, and cost trade off against each other, and how running our own inference changes what we can offer customers.

Daily operational tasks : resolving billing issues, reporting bugs and being the point of for our customers.

You do not need to know all of this on day one. You need to be the kind of person who cannot stop asking  why  until you do.

la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’UFR S2I sur le Campus de Brest.

Projet FLOWATT

Le projet FLOWATT, dans le cadre duquel s’inscrit cette étude, vise à déployer et exploiter six hydroliennes dans les forts courants marins du Raz Blanchard, en Normandie.  Au-delà de la production d’énergie, FLOWATT a pour objectif d’évaluer le potentiel du Raz Blanchard pour le déploiement de fermes hydroliennes à plus grande échelle. Cette évaluation repose notamment sur une caractérisation précise de la ressource, une estimation fine du productible et une meilleure compréhension des impacts environnementaux. Pour répondre à ces enjeux, le projet combine mesures in situ, modélisation numérique et essais expérimentaux afin de fournir les connaissances nécessaires à la préparation des futurs déploiements commerciaux, tout en contribuant à la réduction des coûts de production et à la limitation des impacts sur l’environnement marin.  Dans ce contexte, la caractérisation de l’état de mer constitue un enjeu important, notamment dans une zone soumise à des courants très intenses. La présente étude s’intéresse ainsi aux données de radar HF acquises depuis fin 2017, ainsi qu’à celles qui seront nouvellement enregistrées dans le cadre du projet TidalRace. Le système, de technologie WERA, est réparti sur deux sites distants d’environ 5 km au Cap de la Hague et fonctionne à deux fréquences, 13,5 MHz et 24,5 MHz. Les acquisitions sont réalisées en continu, à raison de quatre mesures par heure, 24 h/24 et 7 j/7, sur une emprise couvrant l’ensemble du Raz Blanchard. Cette couverture temporelle et spatiale offre ainsi une opportunité unique de suivre l’évolution des états de mer dans des conditions hydrodynamiques particulièrement contraintes.  L’exploitation de ces données nécessite toutefois d’adapter les méthodes de traitement aux conditions de forts courants. L’objectif des travaux est donc d’améliorer les algorithmes existants et, si nécessaire, d’en développer de nouveaux afin de restituer de manière fiable les spectres d’énergie des vagues en fréquence et en direction, ainsi que les paramètres moyens associés. Une première étape consistera à comprendre les limites des méthode

About the AI Security Institute

The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.

As the models we test get more capable and the environments we run them in get more sensitive, we have to continue to be able to run evaluations of highly capable models under proper control and ensure that it remains governed well. Building that governance and keeping it fast is what lets AISI keep pace with the work in front of it.

The Security Engineering team keeps AISI's research platform, evaluation environments, and sensitive data secure, and runs the governance, risk, and compliance around them. You'll work with the team's engineers and the researchers whose work this governs.

jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Senior Garment Technologist

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About Boltz  Boltz is a public benefit company building the next generation of AI-powered molecular modeling tools to make biology programmable and accelerate drug discovery, while keeping frontier capabilities broadly accessible.  Boltz was founded by former MIT scientists who created Boltz-1, the first fully commercially available open-source model to approach AlphaFold 3-level accuracy in predicting the 3D structure of biomolecular complexes.  We focus on two things:

Foundation models.  Our open models, Boltz-1, Boltz-2 and BoltzGen, are trusted by 100,000+ scientists across biotech and academia, and used in programs at every Top 20 pharma as well as leading agrichemical and industrial research organizations. Our latest proprietary foundation models power our products and the custom models we build with partners.

Boltz Lab and the Boltz API.  Our products run our latest models, design pipelines (BoltzMol for small molecules, BoltzProt for protein design) and agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules in Boltz Lab, run our models from their own code and agents through the Boltz API, or deploy them inside their own environment.

The two feed each other: our open releases earn scientific credibility and community insight, and our products turn our full range of models into real impact for partners including Pfizer, Takeda, GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb and DSM-Firmenich.  You can read more about our mission, research and product vision in our  manifesto .

You will work with every engineering team at Boltz, and you will sit across the table from the security leaders of the world's largest pharma companies. Vorweg, damit wir uns die Zeit sparen:  Diese Rolle ist neu bei uns. Du verbindest Beratung, Technik und Prototyping – und bist dabei schneller als jede Folie.  Wenn ein Kunde im Workshop sagt „Unsere Produktdaten sind ein Chaos“, willst du kein Konzept schreiben, das in drei Wochen fertig ist. Du willst ihm am Nachmittag zeigen, wie es aussehen könnte.  Wenn du bei „Workshop“ an Moderationskarten und Flipchart denkst, wird das hier nichts. Wenn du dabei an deinen Laptop mit Claude Code denkst: lies weiter.

Wer wir sind

creativestyle ist eine E-Commerce-Agentur mit deutsch-polnischem Setup: Beratung und Projektmanagement in München, Entwicklung in Krakau und Rybnik. Über 120 umgesetzte Shops, rund 110 Leute, Kunden wie NKD, Mövenpick, CEWE Fotobuch, Einhell und Bergzeit.  Dieses Jahr haben wir richtig abgeräumt:  Agentur des Jahres , dazu zwei Auszeichnungen gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden – Best Customer Experience mit benuta, Best Mobile Experience mit Bergzeit.  Was das im Alltag bedeutet:

Jede und jeder bei uns hat einen technischen Background. Die Geschäftsführung eingeschlossen.

50 % Freiheit, 50 % Verantwortung. Beides gilt gleichzeitig.

Fehler sind bei uns Lektionen, keine Schuldfrage. Wir steigen nur ungern zweimal in denselben Fluss.

Corporate sind wir nicht. Unzuverlässig allerdings auch nicht.

Wir nehmen keine Projekte an, auf die wir keine Lust haben.

Warum wir diese Stelle gerade jetzt schaffen

Zwei Gründe, beide ehrlich:

1. Unsere Kunden wollen keine Shops mehr. Sie wollen Lösungen.  Produktdaten, ERP, Schnittstellen, Automatisierung, KI – die spannenden Fragen liegen heute zwischen den Systemen. Dafür brauchen wir Leute, die im Workshop zuhören, verstehen, wo es wirklich weh tut, und einen Vorschlag auf den Tisch legen, den man anfassen kann.

2. KI verändert, wie Beratung funktioniert.  Ein Prototyp dauert heute Stunden statt Wochen. Wir wollen Kunden nicht erklären, was möglich wäre – wir wollen es ihnen zeigen. Du bist die erste Person in dieser Rolle und gestaltest sie von Anfang an mit.

Deine Mission

Verstehen, bevor du löst.  Du führst Discovery-Workshops mit unseren Kunden: Prozesse, Datenflüsse, Systemlandschaft. Du fragst so lange nach, bis klar ist, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt – und das steht selten im Briefing.

Nie mit leeren Händen kommen.  Vor dem Workshop baust du eine erste Version. Im Workshop diskutiert ihr am konkreten Beispiel statt an abstrakten Folien. Manchmal iterierst du live, während alle zuschauen.

Vibe-Coding als Werkzeug, nicht als Spielerei.  Vor allem mit Claude Code baust du in Stunden einen klickbaren Prototyp: ein PIM-Datenmodell, einen Schnittstellen-Mock, einen KI-Agenten, der Produkttexte schreibt. Produktionscode schreiben unsere Devs in Polen. Dein Job ist zu zeigen, was möglich ist.

Lösungen skizzieren, die halten.  Shop, PIM, ERP, KI – du zeichnest, wer was macht, wo die Daten leben und wie die Systeme miteinander reden. Und du kannst begründen, warum.

Die Brücke ins Team.

jobs.title: Lead 2D Artist
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for an Lead 2D Artist to join our MONOPOLY GO! Game team in Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis (3X week in office).

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

What You Will Do

  • Establish and uphold the 2D vision for each season, in close partnership with Content Leadership, Principal Artist and the Art Director.
  • Set the bar for quality, technical craft, and AI-assisted workflows, and hold both internal and outsourced artists to it.
  • Identifying where Ai assisted workflows create meaningful production value, establishing standards for quality and consistency, and turning successful experimentation into repeatable practices the wider team can adopt.
  • Own and continuously improve 2D's art standards and guideline documentation, partnering with Integration and Technical Art on implementation.
  • Manage and mentor the discipline, owning performance reviews, goal-setting, and team health.
  • Take part in hiring to make sure new hires are the right fit, and champion the team's culture.
  • Be the primary point of contact and voice for 2D, coordinating the discipline's work with the rest of production, from planning through delivery.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years experience as a 2D/concept artist working in games, including 3+ years leading, mentoring, and setting the artistic bar for a team.
  • Demonstrated experience developing, scaling, and driving adoption of AI-assisted creative workflows, with the judgment to evaluate their impact on quality, consistency, efficiency, and downstream production.
  • Track record shipping multiple mobile titles in casual/whimsical art styles, partnering across Design, Engineering, and outsourcing to deliver high-quality content.
  • Expert-level 2D illustration and concept skills, including composition, form, and color, backed by mastery of Photoshop and a strong ability to research and reference material that supports idea generation.
  • Positive attitude and the ability to give and receive objective feedback.

Bonus Points

  • Experience navigating the brand guidelines and approval pipeline of at least one externally-licensed IP.
  • Experience managing or supporting multiple outsourcing partners while holding their output to a consistent quality standard.
  • Strong 3D modeling proficiency in Maya, Ble

jobs.title: Staff Talent Acquisition Partner, EMEA
jobs.description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

Staff Talent Acquisition Partner, EMEA

As a member of our Global Talent team, the Staff Talent Acquisition Partner in EMEA drives the recruiting process end to end across Fastly, hiring great people for teams across the Revenue and Client Services organizations in EMEA. You'll spend most of your time driving requisitions from kickoff to offer, and you'll also serve as a go-to resource for our regional leaders.

We partner closely with hiring managers to identify and hire top-performing candidates. We deliver a best-in-class candidate experience that gives genuine insight into our culture and what it's like to work at Fastly. We're looking for a seasoned recruiter who brings a passion for technology, creativity, and a solutions mindset.

What You'll Do

Your primary focus

  • Own a full requisition load across all functions in EMEA, from intake to offer.
  • Partner with hiring managers up to VP level to build hiring plans and strategies for high-performing talent.
  • Source and engage passive candidates through multiple channels, including LinkedIn.
  • Build talent pipelines through creative sourcing campaigns, tactical research, referrals, and events.
  • Run the interview and hiring decision process with interviewers and hiring managers.
  • Drive offers in partnership with hiring managers and the Compensation team.
  • Recommend improvements to sourcing, process, and outreach.
  • Deliver a great candidate experience from start

jobs.title: Curriculum Manager - AI Engineering
jobs.description:
About DataCamp

Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors.

In this role, you’ll combine AI skills, technical expertise, and passion for great didactic experiences to usher in the next generation of education.

About the role

This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with subject matter experts and leverage in-house-built cutting-edge AI tooling to scale high-quality course creation across AI engineering: building applications with large language models (LLMs), prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and related topics such as evaluation, fine-tuning, guardrails, and LLMOps. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

  • Manage the entire content development lifecycle and deadlines.
  • Source and recruit top-tier subject-matter experts as instructors.
  • Collaborate with instructors to create engaging content.
  • Consistently leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and more to drive high-quality content production at scale.
  • Design, review, and create content on LLM application development, prompt and context engineering, RAG and vector databases, agents and tool use, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of AI systems, and related topics. You will review content from a learner perspective, ensuring it is technically accurate, reflects current AI engineering best practices in a fast-moving field, and is pedagogically effective.
  • Continuously assess course performance using learner feedback and engagement data to drive improvements.
  • Identify and prioritize existing curriculum gaps or new topics in DataCamp's AI engineering curriculum.

We’re excited about you because you have the following:

  • A solid hands-on background building and shipping production AI applications as an AI engineer, machine learning engineer, or software engineer. Experience taking LLM-powered systems from prototype to production (e.g. evaluation, monitoring, cost and latency optimization) is a strong plus.
  • Broad AI engineering fluency spanning LLM fundamentals, prompt and context engineering, RAG, agents, and evaluation, with additional depth in at least one area such as agentic systems, retrieval and search, fine-tuning, or LLMOps.
  • A solid technical background in Python, with comfort working with LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic), open-source models and frameworks (e.g. Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex), agentic systems, vector databases, Git, and the command line.
  • Intuitive understanding of instruc

jobs.title: Senior Inside Sales Representative (Paris, France)
jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a Senior Inside Sales Representative, you’ll help retain and grow Figma’s existing customers. You’ll manage renewals and expansion opportunities across an assigned book of business, including accounts where an Account Executive is on leave, territories where we’re hiring, and customers with multiple Figma organizations. You’ll understand how customers work, connect their needs to Figma’s platform and AI capabilities, and guide commercial conversations that reinforce value and address potential reductions in spend. Working closely with Sales and cross-functional partners, you’ll own customer opportunities from discovery through close.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based out of our Paris hub.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Own a book of existing customer business and deliver against quarterly net revenue retention (NRR) targets by retaining revenue, managing contraction risk, and driving expansion
  • Build trusted customer relationships and uncover business objectives, workflows, adoption challenges, and opportunities to deliver greater value
  • Lead renewal cycles end-to-end, from proactive outreach and discovery through negotiation, close, and billing coordination, including for accounts without a dedicated Account Executive
  • Navigate potential contraction and churn conversations by understanding the underlying drivers, reinforcing customer value, and developing a clear path forward

jobs.description:
Our Mission  At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.  We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role  As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll train locomotion and low-level control policies for our legged security robots and help take them from simulation to real hardware. You'll work close to the actuators, from joint-level behavior through coordinated locomotion, on robots that patrol outdoor sites across varied terrain and challenging weather.  This role is highly practical: you'll design training setups, run experiments in simulation, transfer policies to physical robots, and measure how they hold up. You'll get hands-on experience with the gap between a policy that works in simulation and one that keeps a robot on its feet on wet ground at night.

Train and evaluate reinforcement learning policies for locomotion and low-level control in simulation.

Apply sim-to-real techniques such as domain randomization, reward design, and policy robustness methods, and test the results on physical robots.

Make policies robust to varied terrain, challenging weather, and noisy, delayed, or missing sensor data.

Explore control approaches that transfer across robot embodiments with different actuators and dynamics.

Build evaluation workflows with clear metrics and repeatable experiments, in simulation and on hardware.

Apply solid engineering practices: experiment tracking, version control, reproducible training runs.

Currently pursuing a PhD or recently completed a Master's degree in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a closely related field.

Hands-on experience training reinforcement learning policies for robot control, in simulation or on hardware.

Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or Gazebo.

Solid grounding in robot dynamics and control.

Good coding skills in Python, with PyTorch (or JAX).

Comfortable using Docker and Git in your workflows.

Experience deploying learned policies on physical robots, ideally legged.

Experience with low-level actuator, motor, or joint control

About the team  Most providers make customers migrate their data to them. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives.  Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. Every integration is unique, but the goal is the same every time: ClickHouse should feel like a first-class citizen in every environment. jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer, Shopping Agents

Sage AI Labs · Munich · Full-time · [Remote]

About us

Sage AI Labs is building the infrastructure that lets AI agents transact on the open web. It is one of the few genuinely unsolved problems left in commerce, and whoever solves it sets the defaults everyone else builds on top of.  The company was founded by Sebastian Thrun (founder of Google X and Waymo, Udacity) and is backed by leading venture and strategic investors.

About the role

We build agents that shop for you. They find products across the open web and complete the purchase end to end. Real carts, real payments, and real systems built to stop them.  You would own that. Architecture, code, deploys, monitoring, and on-call for systems that transact around the clock, working directly with our CTO.

What you'll own

Our checkout agents.  Frontier-model computer-use agents driving live checkouts at scale, plus the machinery that keeps them standing when the ground moves. Every retailer breaks differently and they change without warning. Your job is to make failure rare and recovery automatic.

Ingestion at scale.  Take product ingestion from hundreds of sources to thousands. The answer is not more hand-written code. It is infrastructure that generates, validates, and monitors itself.

Search and ranking.  Embedding-based retrieval, LLM query understanding, reranking, and caching, across a catalog that never stops changing.

What we're looking for

5+ years building backend and infrastructure systems, with strong Python

You have owned production systems end to end: deploys, databases, observability, and the pager. You have been the person who got paged, and you fixed the class of problem rather than the incident

You like adversarial problems. Systems where something on the other side is actively working against you

You take correctness seriously because the stakes are real. These systems spend customers' money, so a silent failure is a wrong order, not a red build

You can move without a finished spec. We are small, and the roadmap changes when the market does

Nice to have

Built AI-first products or LLM-based agents in production, not just in a prototype

Working knowledge of classic ML and deep learning, enough to reason about retrieval and ranking rather than only calling an API

Background in e-commerce, payments, or fraud and risk infrastructure

Why this role

Very few engineers get to own a category-defining system while the category is still being defined. This is one of those seats, at the point where it still counts as early. A year from now this problem will have a standard answer and someone will have written it. We intend for that to be us.  Find more  English Speaking Jobs in Germany  on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Graphics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Graphics Engineer. This role can be based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Portugal, Spain or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis. If you're open to working in any of these locations, there's no need to apply more than once. We'll discuss location preferences during the hiring process. We can support with visa sponsorship from any location.

We are looking for strong rendering expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality, high-performance visuals. You will work on real-time rendering features and optimizations that help our game look and run its best across a wide range of devices.

We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title, creating a team of talented and passionate game makers to join us on this exciting journey!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and optimize real-time rendering features on mobile platforms using Vulkan (Android) and Metal (iOS).

  • Work with clustered/meshlet-based geometry systems, implementing GPU-driven visibility, culling, and LOD.

  • Integrate and refine modern rendering techniques such as clustered/tiled lighting, temporal anti-aliasing (TAA), and super-resolution (TSR).

  • Assist in the development of real-time global illumination features in collaboration with senior technical staff, ensuring scalability across different device tiers.

  • Write and optimize shaders (HLSL/GLSL/MSL) for power-efficient mobile performance.

  • Profile GPU/CPU performance and analyze rendering bottlenecks using tools like RenderDoc, Perfetto, Xcode GPU Debugger, and Mali/Snapdragon profilers.

  • Contribute to GPU memory layout design, draw submission strategies, and render pass optimizations for tile-based GPUs.

  • Collaborate closely with engine and content teams to ensure visuals meet quality and performance goals across platforms.

  • Stay informed on industry rendering trends and suggest improvements to our pipeline.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of graphics programming experience, with a focus on mobile platforms.

  • Strong C++ skills with experience working in performance-critical rendering code.

  • Solid knowledge of Vulkan and/or Metal APIs.

  • Experience with Unity’s Scriptable Render Pipeline (SRP), including extending or customizing SRPs.

jobs.title: Senior Server Engineer - Performance
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Server Engineer (Performance) to join a new truly unique multiplayer strategy game in Barcelona on a hybrid basis or remotely in the UK, Ireland, Portugal, and the rest of Spain. If you're open to working in any of these locations, there's no need to apply more than once. We'll discuss location preferences during the hiring process. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

We embrace AI-forward development practices and expect our engineers to be curious and pragmatic about how these tools can raise the bar.

We are in the early stages of development on an ambitious, unannounced Strategy/MMO title, creating a team of talented and passionate game makers to join us on this exciting journey!

What You Will Do

  • Work in a cross-functional agile team and be responsible for designing, developing, and evolving systems that validate and improve the performance, scalability, and reliability of backend services running on AWS
  • Design and implement performance and reliability strategies for our core backend systems, including defining service-level expectations (latency, throughput, error rates) and validating them under realistic conditions
  • Build frameworks and tooling to simulate real-world production scenarios, including multi-service interactions, high concurrency, and network variability

  • Enable a shift-left quality culture by building tooling, patterns, and best practices that allow teams to detect regressions early
  • Collaborate with feature teams to improve system design, resilience, and scalability, acting as a force multiplier across backend engineering
  • Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows in your daily work — from tech planning, code generation and review to exploring novel solutions.

What We’re Looking For

jobs.title: Level Design - Puzzle (Turkish Speaker)
jobs.description:
Homa  is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.  With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.  This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.  Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones. At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.  The team  You join an 8-person puzzle studio in Istanbul, founded by Peak and Zynga alumni. It's backed by Homa's puzzle, data, art, and UA teams. Its new puzzle game is heading to global launch, and fresh levels are now its biggest growth lever.  The opportunity  You own the levels players see every week. You work every day with Homa's product director and the studio's level designers, artists, and engineers. You use a level editor and AI tools that generate layouts and estimate difficulty. AI makes you faster, and you stay the brain behind every level. You work remotely from Türkiye. The team is small, and the bar is high.  As the studio grows, you can own a family of mechanics or a pack of levels. You can also lead a group of level designers, or move toward a product role.  Your responsibilities

Build.  Your levels keep fresh content reaching players, every single week.

Tune.  Your difficulty curve makes levels feel hard but fair, so players keep trying.

Introduce.  New mechanics land smoothly because your levels teach them step by step.

Test.  You play every level before release, so players only see levels that work.

Optimize.  You use win rate, attempts and churn data to turn weak live levels into strong ones.

Shape.  Your ideas on new mechanics and content push the game forward.

Accelerate.  You use AI to generate layout variants, explore difficulty options

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.  Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

We want you as a talented and experienced Mechanism Engineer to help us in our mission by designing, manufacturing, testing and delivering, fully inhouse mechanisms for Nyx. They’ll need a strong understanding of kinematics, statics, material mechanics, stress, and mass properties.

Own the multibody dynamic analysis across the Nyx program to drive design aspects of the program and systems/subsystems teams.

Model, simulate, and verify the Nyx vehicle level separation kinematics/dynamics from the launch vehicle, as well as the capsule to service module separation.

Perform kinematic analysis of deployment, release, and articulated systems, including motion envelopes, clearances, and interference checks.

Support testing and use test data to correlate simulation models.

Perform Finite Element Model (FEM) analysis on various subsystems and their components to assess strength, stiffness, and margins of safety.

Perform acceleration, shock, and random and sine vibration, and derive environmental requirements for components.

Document analysis results in clear reports and present them at design reviews and to stakeholders.

Develop reusable analysis methods, tools, and automation for current and future programs.

In the role as Mechanical Analysis Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

MSc or PhD in Mechanical, Aerospace, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

At least 5 years of professional experience in mechanical analysis, preferably in aerospace, space, or automotive.

Demonstrated expertise in multibody dynamics and kinematics using tools such as MSC Adams, Matlab Simscape, or Modelica

Proficiency in FEA for linear and nonlinear structural analysis, using tools such as Hypermesh, MSC Nastran, Abaqus, or Ansys.

Solid understanding of statics, dynamics, material mechanics, stress analysis, and mass properties.

Experience with shock, vibration, and acoustic analysis, including random vibration and shock response spectrum (SRS) methods.

Experience correlating simulation models with test data.

Strong oral and written communication skills.

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.  We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job  Mistral AI is looking for a Domain Expert in  crashworthiness simulations  to help build AI-accelerated simulation capabilities for industrial engineering. You will work with research, product, and customer-facing teams to ensure that our models are useful against real engineering standards — not only benchmark metrics.  Relevant application areas may include automotive crashworthiness, aerospace structures, consumer-electronics drop/reliability, manufacturing, durability/fatigue, and other nonlinear structural mechanics problems.

Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ontwikkelen we bovendien ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken een Senior HR Business Partner die ons team door een verandertraject begeleidt en adviseert.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Lefebvre Sdu transformeert van uitgever naar techbedrijf. Nergens is dat zo voelbaar als in ons product team. De mensen die hier werken bouwen het platform waarop onze AI-revolutie draait, en ze doen dat terwijl de organisatie om hen heen verandert. 70 mensen nu, vacatures open, en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR Adviseur die dit team begeleidt. Niet op afstand, maar als iemand die begrijpt wat er speelt, de juiste vragen stelt en mensen vooruit helpt. Dit ga je doen:

Jij bent de HR-partner van het team dat onze transformatie mogelijk maakt. Wat hier speelt is direct voelbaar in de hele organisatie.

Je begeleidt managers en medewerkers in het content, tech- en IT-team op alle HR vraagstukken, van instroom tot ontwikkeling.

Je signaleert wat er speelt in het team en vertaalt dat naar concrete HR-interventies die werken.

Je adviseert managers bij veelvoorkomende thema’s rondom leiderschap, performance en talent development.

Je draagt actief bij aan de cultuurverandering die bij deze transformatie hoort.

Je werkt nauw samen met je collega HR Adviseurs en de Head of People aan de verdere opbouw van het people team.

DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je hebt affiniteit met cultuurtrajecten en leiderschapsprogramma's en denkt mee over hoe die eruit moeten zien bij Lefebvre Sdu.

Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

3 to 5+ years of instructional design or curriculum development for adult learners, with a portfolio of published, assessment-backed courses.

Experience building on an LMS and writing valid assessments and item

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐  About the team

The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement.

Alma Wallet  builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets.

Consumer Engagement  drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently.

In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth.

This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France.

Roblox’s data platform processes petabytes of data daily, powering analytics, ML, and product decisions. The Data Platform Compute team owns the compute layer underneath it: the Kubernetes (EKS) clusters where all of Roblox’s Spark workloads run, and the software that lets engineers, analysts, and ML practitioners submit and run that work reliably and cost-effectively.

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will build and operate the systems that sit between our users and the cluster. These include the Spark job submission service, our internal Spark libraries, interactive notebook compute, and cluster lifecycle automation. You’ll have real ownership, you’ll work on problems where the design is not yet settled, and you’ll help decide which technologies Roblox adopts next.

  • Build and own core compute platform services: Design, build, and operate the software behind Spark job submission, including APIs, scheduling integration, and the libraries users depend on.
  • Launch interactive Spark at scale: Deliver Spark Connect to support notebook workflows, including provisioning and managing the EKS compute that backs them, with sensible isolation, resource limits, and cost controls.
  • Run a safe, automated cluster fleet: Build fleet management automation for EKS, such as blue-green rollouts that validate new AMIs and Kubernetes versions before they reach production workloads, with minimal disruption to running jobs.
  • Make jobs run better without user effort: Develop our auto-tuner, which analyzes Spark history and event logs to recommend or apply job configuration changes that improve performance and reduce cost.
  • Own batch scheduling on Kubernetes: Operate and upgrade our YuniKorn-based scheduling, including queue design, quotas, fairness across tenants, and version upgrades.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Sr. Studio Software Engineer, not only will you be one of the coolest humans on the planet; you will also be a key contributor to the evolution of Roblox Studio which is the primary IDE for making massive multiplayer online games on the Roblox platform. Who wouldn’t want to do that? Studio provides tools for 3D modeling, animation, complete SDLC and testing for teams and individual game developers. This role does not require experience in the aforementioned. Large scale desktop application experience will suffice.

You’ll work on projects involving:

  • Core user features - UI frameworks,, windowing systems, code generation
  • “AI Native” features - building well integrated AI features into Studio
  • Foundational application architecture, including OS integration and building our our third party plugin ecosystem.
  • Working with UX designers for overall design language for Studio both on visual, motion, and interactive elements.
  • Building central backend systems

You will:

  • Design and execute on the architecture and technical direction that will be the future of our application
  • Own and deliver complex technical projects from the planning stage through execution
  • Work cross functionally, across teams and technology platforms
  • Mentor team members helping them improve their professional skills and expertise
  • Design, develop, and implement technological practices, patterns, and strategies
  • Participate in building the world's best professional application for massively multiplayer game development

You have:

  • 5+ years in developing and deploying top of the line user facing applications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a similar technical field
  • 1+ years of experience with C++.
  • Experience with UI frameworks like React, Cocoa, WPF, or others

jobs.description:

We are looking for an Intellectual Property Counsel to join Roblox’s Legal and Advocacy team. In this role, you will advise and collaborate with various teams within the business on a broad array of legal matters related to intellectual property, including IP enforcement and protection, intermediary liability and copyright, and trade secrets.

Successful candidates will have strong experience advising on current legal frameworks and risks in the intellectual property space, including infringement assessment, IP disputes, platform liability, global copyright frameworks, artificial intelligence, and other emerging technology issues. This is a great opportunity to join a growing legal team, learn about interesting new technologies and business models, and work on novel issues in an exciting, fast-paced environment.

You will:

  • Help manage active IP disputes end-to-end, partnering with internal teams and outside counsel on case strategy, negotiations, and litigation support.
  • Assess and triage new off-platform infringement reports, provide enforcement recommendations, and coordinate with outside counsel and brand protection vendors.
  • Draft and execute cease-and-desist letters, DMCA takedown notices, and platform-specific IP complaints, while managing brand protection vendors.
  • Oversee the IP notice-and-takedown program, including partnering with Trust and Safety, Developer Relations, and other cross-functional teams to resolve escalations and align on decisions, refining related legal guidance and policy, and counseling feature launches on Roblox’s IP Platform.
  • Drive strategy and execution with respect to on-platform enforcement initiatives and advise on new launches with respect to platform liability issues (e.g., DMCA, EU Digital Services Act).
  • Build and update playbooks, templates, and policies to streamline internal IP team projects, portfolio management, and company-wide programs.
