jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Job Description

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.

You Will:

  • Design and ship 3D engine systems for avatar and environment geometry, including mesh processing, level of detail, transcoding, streaming, runtime loading, and related performance systems.
  • Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences.
  • Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
  • Lead by example: drive projects end-to-end, mentor other engineers, and help set a high bar for technical quality and code health on the team.

You Have:

  • Proven Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
  • Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building at least one production system involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D

As a Software Engineer on the Engine Systems team, you will help build the core diagnostic instrumentation for Roblox’s engine. In this role, support and build the systems that allow us to monitor and analyze Roblox from the hardware level all the way up to end user experience to improve Roblox for our millions of concurrent users.

You will contribute to platform-level systems that help Roblox understand hangs, crashes, performance regressions, and session health across our supported clients. This work requires navigating hardware and vendor-specific limitations across devices, while building reliable systems that help engineering teams safely ship weekly binary updates to Roblox at global scale.

You Will

  • Build and maintain components of the (predominantly C++) systems that report stability, reliability, and performance signals across Roblox clients, working from defined designs and contributing to technical decisions within your area.
  • Write well-instrumented, production-quality code across supported platforms, including mobile, desktop, and major consoles, with guidance on complex systems-level work.
  • Deliver the tools and signals engineers use to detect, understand, and resolve disruptions to the user experience, and help improve them based on feedback from those teams.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Service Mesh
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Who We Are:

Roblox is reimagining the way people come together to connect, create, and express themselves. To support our massive scale, we are powered by thousands of microservices. The Application Networking team connects and secures these services, building ingress gateways, managing the service mesh, and enabling seamless communication across Roblox’s hybrid on-prem and cloud infrastructure.

We are executing on Cloud Bursting, a strategic initiative to enable Roblox’s core services to transparently burst from on-prem data centers to the cloud, allowing us to handle historical peak concurrent players and survive regional failures. You will join our Service Mesh team to build the networking fabric that makes this possible.

You Will:

  • Design and build the service mesh infrastructure that enables communication across Roblox’s hybrid Kubernetes and Nomad environments, supporting billions of daily requests.
  • Drive the integration of service mesh with Kubernetes, ensuring reliable sidecar injection, mTLS, traffic policies, and observability for production workloads.
  • Build the networking foundation for Cloud Bursting, enabling Roblox’s top services to transparently burst from on-prem data centers to the cloud, with service discovery, traffic management, and locality-aware routing across environments.
  • Partner with internal application teams to understand their connectivity pain points, ensuring the service mesh provides a frictionless 'paved road' for thousands of developers
  • Collaborate with the Gateway and CNI teams to deliver a unified, multi-cluster service fabric that abstracts cluster and regional boundaries from application developers.
  • Serve as a primary escalation point for complex service mesh issues, troubleshooting across Envoy sidecars, Istio control plane, and the underlying network stack.
  • Act as a senior voice on the team, mentor

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.

  • Design and implement sandboxes using platform primitives: nsjail, seccomp-bpf, namespaces, cgroups, and Landlock on Linux; the Seatbelt (sandbox_init / SBPL) and related mechanisms on macOS; AppContainer, job objects, restricted tokens, and integrity levels on Windows.

  • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

You Have:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.

  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interfac

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

Global team:  We prioritize your talent, not your location.

You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact.

What You’ll Do:

Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.

We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Integrated Workflows
jobs.description:
The Integrated Workflows team exists to expand Mural's value by embedding it seamlessly into the essential business workflows our customers already live in. We connect Mural to the tools that teams rely on every day, from the systems of record where work gets tracked to the places conversations happen and the surfaces content moves through.

That is what integrations unlock, and it is the most interesting thing about this team. When Mural can reach the work happening everywhere else, a canvas stops being a snapshot of one meeting and becomes a live surface for how a team operates: real context pulled in, real decisions pushed back out, nobody retyping a status update or hunting for the current version. A workshop stops ending at the wall of sticky notes and starts ending in tracked, owned, moving work. That is when collaboration gets genuinely effective, and building toward it is the point of everything we do.

Underneath all of that, we build the integration platform: the shared frameworks, services, and patterns that let any team at Mural ship a connected experience without starting from scratch. Our mission: to make Mural a natural part of daily work. We measure success by how indispensable Mural becomes inside real customer workflows, not by the number of integrations we ship.

YOUR MISSION

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Integrated Workflows team, you'll own significant parts of how Mural connects to the outside world. You'll design and build integrations that are reliable, secure, and genuinely used, and you'll turn one-off connector work into integration platform capabilities the rest of the company can build on.

This role sits at the intersection of product and platform. You'll work directly against third-party APIs and SDKs with all the ambiguity that entails: shifting contracts, rate limits, auth models, partner review processes. At the same time you'll keep our own abstractions clean and our public API stable for the developers who depend on it.

Senior Engineers at Mural lead, design, and implement complex technical projects, contribute to team and company-wide processes and culture, and provide mentorship and support for early-career colleagues.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build and evolve two-way sync with the systems of record where customer work lives (Jira, Linear, Asana, and others), so decisions made on the canvas become tracked work and stay in sync as that work changes

Design, build, and maintain integrations across the Microsoft ecosystem (Teams, Outlook, Office), video conferencing platforms, and third-party notification targets such as Slack and Teams

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Customs
jobs.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Why Customs Matters More Than Ever

International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis — sparked by Trump-era tariffs — has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt.

That’s where we come in. The Customs Technology team at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing.

The Opportunity

Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough.

Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. Being a tech company, we can move much faster than our competitors, and give our customers the service they expect in this day and age. We can deploy things like LLM agents at scale, in an industry that is ripe to be disrupted by this technology.

What You’ll Do

As an Engineering Manager in the Customs Technology team, you’ll lead a group of exceptional engineers to:

  • Build world class tools like our Tariff Simulator, the only tool that gives businesses a real view of landed costs before they ship.
  • Automate customs processes to an unprecedented level. Most customs are text based work, which is what agents excel at.
  • Design scalable systems that automate classification, compliance, and filings—turning weeks of work into seconds.
  • Partner with product, design, and operations to deliver technology that gives clients clarity, cost savings, and risk control.

Je neemt eigenaarschap over onze data offering, je volgt de prestaties, signaleert verbeterkansen en werkt continu aan de verdere ontwikkeling van ons aanbod. Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding.

jobs.title: AI Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Hoe lang duurt dit ziekteverzuim? Hoeveel stroom levert het windpark morgen? Welke klant staat open voor een volgend product? Organisaties willen het antwoord weten voordat het zover is. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer zorg jij dat die voorspelling er komt: betrouwbaar, herhaalbaar en verankerd in het werk van echte gebruikers.

De uitdaging

Generatieve AI trekt de aandacht, maar predictive AI levert vaak de harde waarde. De twee lossen verschillende problemen op en versterken elkaar. Jij weet welke aanpak bij welk vraagstuk past, en waar de grenzen liggen.

Als AI Machine Learning Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers

,

zoals overheden, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Daar tref je vaak data waar nog veel meer uit te halen valt. Jij maakt er producten op basis van AI van die werken.

Je werk bestaat onder meer uit:

Statistische analyses en dataverkenning om haalbaarheid en aanpak snel helder te krijgen.

Data pipelines bouwen en de juiste featureset samenstellen voor modeltraining.

Modellen ontwikkelen, van gradient boosting tot deep learning.

Modelregistratie, experiment tracking en modelvisualisaties op orde houden.

Modellen ontsluiten via FastAPI, zodat ze aanroepbaar zijn binnen het bestaande applicatielandschap.

Met coding agents vind je sneller de juiste libraries en creeër je inzicht zodat de haalbaarheid en juiste aanpak snel boven water komen. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat AI wel en niet kan. Je werkt pragmatisch en zet door tot de mensen voor wie je modellen bedoeld zijn ze dagelijks gebruiken.

Je plek

Je sluit aan bij de AI& Data Squad: Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Onze ambitie is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland te worden. Daarvoor bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot voorspelmodellen op Databricks. Jij denkt daar actief over mee.

Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag met alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag: een dag voor kennisdelen, leren en verbinden.

Lees

hier

meer over de AI squad.

Wat we vragen

Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als ontwikkelaar, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met AI en machine learning.

Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering.

Ervaring met modellen en frameworks zoals LightGBM, XGBoost en Keras.

Ervaring met platformen als Azure ML, Databricks, AWS SageMaker of GCP Vertex AI.

Ervaring met pandas, polars of Spark, en met exploratie in Jupyter en Seaborn.

Ervaring met tracking en orkestratie via MLflow, Prefect of Airflow.

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Iedereen wil AI. Nog weinig organisaties weten waar dat moet draaien, wie erbij mag en hoe je het veilig houdt. Als AI Platform Engineer bouw jij het fundament dat die vragen beantwoordt: infrastructuur waarop AI direct inzetbaar, veilig en geborgd is. Geen proof of concept die in een la verdwijnt, maar een platform waar organisaties op durven te bouwen.

De uitdaging

Voor veel organisaties is infrastructuur voor AI nieuw terrein. Data scientists willen experimenteren terwijl security precies wil weten wie waarbij kan. Als AI Platform Engineer bouw jij de omgeving waarin beide kan. Je ontwerpt landing zones, netwerken en GPU capaciteit die aansluiten op het cloudlandschap dat er al ligt. Je richt private endpoints en netwerksegmentatie in, regelt toegang met RBAC en managed identities en zet model endpoints achter een API gateway. Je werkt met verified modules voor Azure, AWS of Kubernetes, binnen het beleid en de architectuur van de klant.

Je komt in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, zoals overheidsorganisaties, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Met code agents schrijf je Infrastructure as Code in Bicep of CDK, die automatisch gecontroleerd en uitgerold wordt via CI/CD. Zo combineer je snelheid met betrouwbaarheid waarover niet onderhandeld wordt.

Je plek

Je landt in de AI&Data Squad: Explorers die al jaren cloud en AI-infrastructuur bouwen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waarin we de komende jaren fors investeren. We bouwen aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot voorspelmodellen op Azure Databricks. De ambitie: dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland worden. Omdat de squad in opbouw is, heb jij directe invloed op die koers.  Om de twee weken komen alle Explorers samen op de clubdag in De Meern, voor kennisdeling, leren en verbinden.

Lees

hier

meer over de AI squad.

Wat we vragen

Minimaal vier jaar ervaring als cloud of infra engineer, waarvan minimaal twee jaar met AI/ML infrastructuur.

Ervaring met cloud engineering op public cloud (AWS of Azure), bonuspunten voor Kubernetes-kennis.

Ervaring met Infrastructure as Code, zoals Ansible, Terraform, Bicep of CDK.

Ervaring met CI/CD en deployment via bijvoorbeeld GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps of ArgoCD.

Je kunt onderbouwen welke tool of aanpak in welke situatie het beste werkt en volgt nieuwe ontwikkelingen op de voet.

Pré

Ervaring met Kubernetes-tooling zoals k9s of Freelens.

Een certificering op het gebied van cloud, AI of Kubernetes (Azure, AWS, GCP of CNCF)

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

Salaris tussen €4.000 - €7.900 per maand  (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Dit is een brede range omdat wij zowel op zoek zijn naar medior als senior Engineers.

jobs.title: GenAI Engineer
jobs.description:
Iedereen kan een prompt schrijven. Een AI-oplossing bouwen waar een organisatie echt op durft te vertrouwen, is een ander vak. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) maak jij het verschil tussen een interessante demo en een oplossing die elke dag werkt in een echt proces. Daarbij stuur je op drie dingen: sneller werken, betere antwoorden en minder repetitief werk voor de eindgebruiker.

De uitdaging

Generatieve AI ontwikkelt zich razendsnel. Toch willen organisaties voorspelbare en gerichte oplossingen die passen in hun informatievoorziening en processen. Als GenAI Engineer (medior/senior) kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, zoals de overheid, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM.

Je werkt met de nieuwste frontier modellen en met platformen als Databricks, AWS Bedrock en Azure Foundry. Daarmee verken en bouw je robuuste implementaties: agentic workflows, LLM-teksttransformaties en RAG. Vaak pak je oplossingen op die in het lab veelbelovend bleken, en zet jij de laatste stap naar een echt proces. Evaluatie, feedback, monitoring en kostenbeheersing zijn daarbij geen bijzaak. Juist daardoor ontstaat de kwaliteit en het vertrouwen waarmee een oplossing landt.

Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat wel én niet kan met AI. Je brengt pragmatische kennis in en zet door tot echte gebruikers jouw AI-output inzetten bij hun taken.

Je plek

Je sluit aan bij het AI&Data Engineering squad. Daar werk je met Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Samen bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot strak gemonitorde workflows met meerdere agents op Azure Foundry. Ons doel is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland worden, en daar heb jij directe invloed op.

Om de twee weken komen alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag. Die dag is er tijd om te leren, kennis te delen en elkaar te spreken.

Lees

hier

meer over de AI squad.

Wat we vragen

Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als developer of data scientist, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met GenAI toepassingen.

Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering.

Ervaring met het open source LLM-ecosysteem, zoals LangChain, DeepEval of DSPy.

Ervaring met commerciële opties, zoals AWS AgentCore of Microsoft Agent Framework.

Ervaring met serving tools, zoals FastAPI, FastMCP, serverless of containeromgevingen.

Ervaring met monitoring en promptbeheer met MLflow of cloud native tools, of de drive om je daarin te verdiepen.

Je begrijpt hoe LLMs en andere generatieve AI werken en je volgt de ontwikkeling van prompt naar context naar harness engineering.

Je weet dat serieuze toepassingen strikte evaluatie, goede monitoring en feedbackloops vragen, en je bouwt die er vanaf het begin in.

jobs.title: Product Owner Q-Bridge / WebOrder
jobs.description:
Product Owner Q-Bridge / WebOrder

Heemstede en Dordrecht | 32-40 uur per week

Ben jij een Product Owner die energie krijgt van het verder ontwikkelen en toekomstbestendig maken van een softwareproduct? Voor Q-Bridge / WebOrder zoeken we iemand die de regie neemt over de continuïteit, modernisering en groei van het platform. Jij bewaakt niet alleen de dagelijkse prestaties van het product, maar bepaalt ook de koers voor de toekomst.

Wat ga je doen?

Je werkt nauw samen met development, support, operations en sales en bent de verbindende schakel tussen klant, product en techniek. Met jouw visie geef je richting aan de productontwikkeling en zorg je ervoor dat Q-Bridge / WebOrder blijft aansluiten op de behoeften van zowel bestaande als nieuwe doelgroepen.

Je werkt vanuit onze locatie in Heemstede en bent minimaal twee dagen per week aanwezig op onze locatie in Dordrecht. Zo blijf je nauw betrokken bij de verschillende teams en de organisatie.

Een veelzijdige rol voor iemand die eigenaarschap durft te nemen, strategisch kan denken én graag zichtbaar resultaat boekt in een product dat dagelijks door klanten wordt gebruikt.

Wat zijn je werkzaamheden?

Je bepaalt en bewaakt de productvisie en roadmap van Q-Bridge/WebOrder en geeft richting aan de verdere modernisering van het product.

Je prioriteert productontwikkeling samen met development en bewaakt de continuïteit, kwaliteit en stabiliteit van de applicatie.

Je zorgt dat contractuele afspraken, wet- en regelgeving en compliance-eisen op orde zijn en stuurt op een financieel gezond en winstgevend product.

Je bewaakt de balans tussen klantwensen, maatwerk en productstandaardisatie en vertaalt feedback van belangrijke klanten en ontwikkelingen in de markt naar concrete productkeuzes.

Je werkt samen met Sales aan commerciële kansen en productproposities. Sales blijft verantwoordelijk voor de verkoop en commerciële resultaten.

Je zorgt dat productkennis wordt opgebouwd, geborgd en toegankelijk gemaakt binnen de organisatie.

Je optimaliseert de ondersteuning rondom het product door supportvragen, bugs en klantwensen te structureren en terugkerende issues te vertalen naar structurele productverbeteringen.

Je benut AI om product support verder te automatiseren, onder andere door een Domain AI Assistant te ontwikkelen en te voeden met actuele productkennis.

Je werkt samen met development aan de verdere modernisering van Q-Bridge/WebOrder en de aansluiting op de NextGen-architectuur.

Waar ligt de focus?

In deze rol kijk je niet alleen naar wat er vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar waar Q-Bridge/WebOrder naartoe moet. Je brengt eerst rust, structuur en continuïteit, om vervolgens gericht te bouwen aan een toekomstbestendig product.

Op korte termijn ligt de focus op:

Het borgen van de continuïteit, stabiliteit en kwaliteit van het product.

Het op orde brengen van contractuele en juridische afspraken.

Het borgen van productkennis en development-capability binnen de organisatie.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist BI
jobs.description:
Data Scientist BI - Senior

Almere | 32–40 uur | Hybride | €4.500–€6.800 bruto per maand

Als Senior Data Scientist BI help je de organisatie maximaal waarde uit data te halen. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar concrete inzichten, dashboards, voorspellende modellen en AI-toepassingen die bijdragen aan betere processen, besluitvorming en aantoonbare businesswaarde.

Als Data Scientist maak je onderdeel uit van het Business Intelligence team. Het BI-team ondersteunt alle labels binnen de MSPS Groep. Hierdoor krijg je te maken met uiteenlopende vraagstukken en draag je bij aan organisatiebrede besluitvorming, KPI's en strategische inzichten. Je werkt nauw samen met stakeholders om datagedreven werken verder te ontwikkelen en de organisatie te ondersteunen met data- en AI oplossingen. Hierbij ben je niet alleen technisch sterk, maar begrijp je ook de business en weet je stakeholders mee te nemen in de mogelijkheden van data en AI.

Wat zijn je belangrijkste taken:

Ontwikkelen, implementeren en beheren van datawarehouses, datamodellen en ETL-processen voor de ontsluiting, integratie en analyse van data en zorgdragen voor gecontroleerde implementatie van wijzigingen (releasemanagement).

Analyseren van informatiebehoeften en businessvraagstukken en het vertalen naar passende BI- en data science oplossingen voor stuurinformatie.

Leveren van organisatiebrede stuurinformatie, analyses, voorspellende modellen en AI-oplossingen ter ondersteuning van tactische en strategische besluitvorming.

Identificeren van kansen om meer waarde uit beschikbare data te halen, waaronder AI- en advanced analytics-toepassingen.

Verbeteren en borgen van de kwaliteit, integriteit, betrouwbaarheid en adoptie van data- en BI-oplossingen.

Mede vormgeven van de roadmap, architectuur en lifecycle van het Data & BI-product en bijdragen aan een toekomstbestendig data- en BI-landschap.

Coachen van collega's, uitvoeren van peer reviews en actief bijdragen aan kennisdeling binnen het team.

Actief bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van het BI-team naar een high-performing team met een sterke data-, innovatie- en verbetercultuur.

Wat breng je mee?

Een afgeronde WO-opleiding in een kwantitatieve richting, zoals Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Econometrie, Wiskunde, Informatica of Business Analytics.

Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Data Science, Business Intelligence, Analytics of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.

Ervaring met het ontwikkelen van datamodellen, dashboards, stuurinformatie en geavanceerde analyses.

Ervaring met AI-, machine learning- en/of voorspellende modellen.

Kennis van data-architectuur, datamanagement en lifecycle management.

Het vermogen om complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar begrijpelijke inzichten en concrete aanbevelingen.

Ervaring met het samenwerken met business stakeholders, productteams en technische teams binnen een complexe en dynamische organisatie.

Een proactieve houding waarbij je kansen signaleert en initiatief neemt om meer waarde uit

Introduction

The digital patient journey at Wellis is growing rapidly and becoming more complex. To take it to the next level, we're looking for a Product Manager Web & App. You will own the product roadmap and prioritization across our web platform and mobile app-from first visit and prescription flow through onboarding, subscriptions, and long-term engagement. Working closely with engineering, UX/UI, data, and key stakeholders across medical operations, marketing, and customer care, you'll turn insights into shipped improvements and experiments that lift conversion, retention, and satisfaction. Wellis is a fast-growing healthtech scale-up that is reinventing one of the most traditional sectors: healthcare. Our mission is to improve everyday lives by making care accessible, personal, and seamless. Through our platform, people can take control of their health journey with trusted medical support, smart digital tools, and tailored programs. We move fast, challenge conventions, and build solutions that truly make an impact, because we believe better healthcare should be within everyone's reach.

You will start by owning the web platform and the mobile app together across the full digital patient journey. Both are first-class products. Our platform covers the full journey: from diagnosis and medical assessment to prescription and delivery at home. jobs.title: DevOps/Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Do you want to own the infrastructure under a health-tech operation that touches hundreds of thousands of lives? This is a dedicated infrastructure, security, and platform role, and there's a lot of ground to claim. Right now a handful of engineers keep the whole stack running between them. Your job is to turn that into something that runs and scales on purpose, and to make it more secure while you do. The more reliable we are, the more people we help lead healthier, happier lives.

About Wellis

Wellis is a fast-growing healthtech scale-up reinventing healthcare. We are building the first truly integrated health platform in the Netherlands, offering on-demand care for everyday health needs such as weight loss, hair loss, sexual health, and more. Our platform covers the full journey: from diagnosis and medical assessment to prescription and delivery at home. By combining medical expertise, technology, and data, we make healthcare smarter, more accessible, more personal, and easier to use. We are growing quickly, which means we are building the structures, teams, products, and processes that will help us scale responsibly. You will join an ambitious, international team where ownership is encouraged, collaboration is key, and impact is visible from day one.

The Role

You won't inherit a mature platform team here. You'll help build one. Our services already run across more than one cloud, most provisioning still happens by hand, and we have very little visibility into what's actually going on in production. Fixing that is the job: bringing order, portability, and security to all of it, and doing it the way our engineering team already works, which is agent-first.  The role covers three areas, and we mean all three. On infrastructure, you'll own how and where we run. We want managed services that stay portable, so we can pick up a workload and move it between GCP, AWS, or anywhere else without rewriting it. On security, you'll own access provisioning, database security, secrets, and the controls a company handling patient data has to get right. On IT and platform admin, you'll own onboarding, offboarding, team access, and tooling: the unglamorous plumbing that keeps a growing team moving.  What ties the three together is automation. We're not looking for someone to click through consoles all day. We're looking for someone who builds the systems and agents that make provisioning, deployment, and access self-serve.  We're an AI-native engineering team. Agentic coding tools are how we work, and infrastructure is no exception. Think Terraform written and reviewed with an agent, runbooks that are actually scripts, an access request that a workflow fulfills on its own. You'll bring that habit to a corner of the company that usually gets it last.

What You'll Own

Provider-agnostic infrastructure.  Define our infra as code so it's reproducible and portable. Containerize workloads, standardize how services get deployed, and keep us free to move between clou

Publitas turns static, dead PDFs into interactive, shoppable digital content discovery experiences for millions of global shoppers. The Benelux market is our crown jewel; we own roughly 90% of the market share in the Netherlands, servicing massive enterprise retail and e-commerce giants.

As our Senior Customer Success Manager for the Dutch market, your mission is to protect, retain, and grow this enterprise portfolio. You are not a passive relationship manager or an email forwarder. You will own the client lifecycle from initial onboarding value to complex commercial renewals, executing with flawless administrative precision in a high-autonomy, remote-first environment.

Your administrative entries are flawless and error-free.

You are executing shadowed calls with strict diagnostic accuracy—uncovering client business objectives, mapping their tech stacks, and catching product adoption blockages early without any internal hand-holding.

What you'll own

A product area with its own customers, roadmap and tech lead. You decide what gets built, in what order, and you carry the outcome.

Your first 90 days

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us  Plentific is a property technology platform used by housing providers, local authorities, housing associations, asset managers, and contractors across the UK and Germany to coordinate repairs, maintenance, and contractor workflows at scale. The platform combines a marketplace, workflow automation, and operational analytics, and is built to handle the volume and compliance demands of social housing, local authority property portfolios, and large-scale residential operations.

We are headquartered in London and our team works across Europe.
We are growing the team to expand the platform's coverage across Europe and to integrate AI throughout the product and operating model. If you are interested in working on hard, real-world problems in a sector that has long been under-served by good software, we would like to hear from you.

The Role  This is a hands-on, fully remote role in one of Plentific's cross-functional product engineering teams. The Senior Backend Engineer works alongside product managers, frontend engineers, quality engineers, and other backend engineers to build and operate the services behind repairs, quoting and invoicing, payments, contractor search, messaging, notifications, and fraud prevention. The role is open across the European countries where we currently employ or engage remote engineers.

Our backend is built primarily in Python and Django, with Django REST Framework and FastAPI supporting APIs in a service-oriented architecture deployed on AWS and Kubernetes. PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery underpin data-intensive and asynchronous workflows. The systems handle complex permissions, legacy integrations, high transaction volumes, and business processes where reliability and data correctness matter.

AI-assisted, spec-driven development is part of normal engineering practice at Plentific. The Senior Backend Engineer turns product requirements into implementation-ready specifications, uses agentic coding tools across implementation, testing, review, and documentation, and remains accountable for the resulting software. AI-generated output is held to the same standard as human-written code. Success means delivering reliable services, improving the codebase and engineering practice around the role, and enabling the wider team to ship confidently at pace.

Key Responsibilities

Backend Engineering

Build and maintain APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python, Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, and related platform tooling.

Design service boundaries, API contracts, relational data models, and integration flows for complex property operations. Produce ERDs and other technical diagrams where they make relationships, ownership, and system behaviour easier to review.

Develop asynchronous and event-driven workflows using technologies such as Celery and Redis.

Write complex SQL, evolve PostgreSQL schemas safely, and optimise database performance where customer experience or operational throughput depends on it.

jobs.title: Country Executive
jobs.description:
Country Executive

The Finance Function Is Broken. Everyone Building For It Is Boring.  Fast-growing multi-entity companies get two options: duct-tape a Frankenstack, or surrender to a corporate ERP and its consultant army. Both are bad. Both are beatable. Beating them market by market is this job.  Light is the AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, smarter every month. We call it organic software. Legora, Lovable and Fuse Energy run on it. Product ships something worth shouting about every single week.  What we don’t have yet is someone who owns each market as their own. We’re hiring Country Executives across several markets. Tell us which one is yours.

This Is Not A Country Manager Role.  Most first-in-market hires get a quota, a deck and a flight. They repeat the London pitch in a local accent and forward complaints to HQ. This is the opposite. This is a founding hire for someone who wants far more scope than their years of experience would get them anywhere else.  No local playbook. You’ll be the person who owns your market, and within a year you should know its complexity (its rules, its buyers, its excuses) better than anyone else. It’s not a leadership title. It’s the seed of one. Do this right and there’s a real path: stand up an entity, build the team around you, move into product, or run the region as GM.

What You’ll Be Doing

Sitting across from finance leaders.  Real conversations, not discovery calls off a script. You find out what they actually need, the thing behind the thing they asked for, and you come back with it written down clearly enough for engineers to build against.

Being the connective tissue.  Customer, product, commercial. What you learn in-market changes how Light builds and how Light sells. You are the wire between them, and the wire has to carry current in both directions.

Owning the local rulebook.  Compliance, regulation, filing, the specific ways finance is done badly in your country. You’re the person in the room who knows this, and you make sure it shows up in the product and in the pitch.

Having a public point of view.  Ideally you arrive with a finance background and an opinion on what “doing finance right” looks like in your market. Bring it into the market, into the roadmap, and into how every prospect sees Light. Relationships, events, brand presence: built by you.

Closing, with London behind you.  Our sales team helps you manage and push deals over the line. You bring the market and customer understanding that makes those conversations land. They support you; they don’t carry you, and you don’t carry it alone.

How We’ll Keep Score  This isn’t a pure revenue seat, but growing your country’s ARR is the primary goal and you’re tied directly to that number. We’ll agree a starting point for what you’re measured against on day one, and you’ll build from there.

What We’ll Ask For*

The thing you built from nothing.  A company, a market, a GTM motion, a pr

jobs.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp  is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world’s largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we’re not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As the  Principal Product Manager, Network Economics  at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team’s well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you’ll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

BetterHelp is looking for a principal-level individual contributor to own therapist compensation and incentives: the economic mechanisms that determine whether a client who needs care can find the right therapist, in their state, under their plan, as soon as possible. We match hundreds of thousands of clients to licensed therapists across every state and a growing set of insurance plans. How quickly that match happens comes down to the strength, size, and variety of our therapist population, and how quickly we can shift it toward the plans and states where clients are waiting.

This individual will own the mechanisms that drive that supply pool, compensation rates, structure, and incentives, as a product and be accountable for the business outcome, not just the shipped feature. That means close collaboration with cross functional stakeholders, deriving defensible answers to how much therapist capacity we actually need and where, and experiments that tell us how the network responds when we change what it earns.

It’s an exciting opportunity for someone who is deeply analytical and does their best work in ambiguity: able to take a problem where the data is incomplete and the stakeholders don’t yet agree, and still reach an effective outcome with the organization behind it. The problems here sit where product, economics, and clinical operations meet, all while making a difference in the lives of people seeking mental health care.

What will you do?

Own the incentive system that moves therapist availability toward where clients actually need it, designed to be targeted, measurable, and reversible

Own the structure and clarity of the compensation model itself: what a therapist can predict about their earn

jobs.title: AI Safety Residency — Scale Labs Preparedness & Policy (SLPreP)
jobs.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with the Preparedness and Policy research team, we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety.

The work includes thinking about various failure modes, evaluating whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Residents take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded.

Research Areas

Mentors will guide AI safety residents on projects in AI safety research areas, such as:

  • AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AI systems, including monitoring their reasoning to detect harmful intent or deception.
  • Alignment red-teaming: Developing science around testing whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies.
  • Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior.
  • Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development.
  • Science of Evaluations: Examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations.
  • Misuse risks: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities.

Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area.

Representative Research

  • ASPI: A benchmark with task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents.
  • PropensityBench: evaluating whether language models choose harmful actions when given simulated dangerous tools under various operational pressures
  • BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing.
  • RSI Control: evaluating whether frontier models can covertly sabotage R&D efforts in the RSI loop.

See more work from the Human Frontier Collective.

What You'll

We are seeking a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead our Frontier AI Infrastructure team within Public Sector Engineering. The UK is making a wholesale shift to AI: government, from the AI Opportunities Action Plan through to the tools the Incubator for AI is putting in front of civil servants, and enterprises racing to put AI to work. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Product Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Scale is accelerating the development of AI across the world's most important organizations. The Forward Deployed PM is the person who makes enterprise deployments succeed from the product side — embedded with customers, shaping real production outcomes, and translating messy operational reality into high-signal input for the core platform.

This is not a roadmap PM, a CSM, or a solutions engineer. The FDPM owns product outcomes inside a portfolio of enterprise accounts: earning deep trust with senior customer stakeholders, driving deployments to production, identifying where the product is the bottleneck vs. execution, and feeding durable, specific signal back to the platform team. The best FDPMs have shipped products into large organizations and can tell the difference between a customer's stated request, their actual problem, and what the platform should do.

As an Infrastructure Engineer on the Apps Platform Infrastructure team, you'll help build and evolve our platform’s deployment and observability layers across multiple cloud providers and on-premises, for both internal and customer-managed environments. You'll partner closely with internal teams to understand how they use and deploy the platform, debug their issues, and shape a roadmap that balances immediate needs with long-term architecture.

You will:

The Role:

Scale AI is hiring a highly skilled foundational IT Systems Engineer for our Public Sector IT team to design, build, and operate secure, scalable infrastructure that empowers employees to do their best work. You’ll join a creative, fast-moving, solutions-oriented group that architects and implements automation across identity and access management, endpoint management, and our broader SaaS stack. Leveraging Okta, Gsuite, AWS, and your familiarity with federal frameworks (FedRAMP High, IL6, CMMC), you’ll deliver robust, audit-ready systems that meet stringent compliance requirements. The ideal candidate pairs deep IAM best practices and hands-on SaaS administration with a zero-trust mindset, clear documentation, and a genuine drive to make people happy, while protecting system integrity in a fast-paced, high-security environment.

  • Create and update technology documentation for internal IT teams and Scale employees
  • Design and maintain Zero-Trust controls (device posture, network segmentation, Conditional Access) across Okta.

  • Experience with leveraging Okta or similar identity management systems for authentication and provisioning methods such as SAML, OIDC, and SCIM
  • Scripting experience with Python, Powershell, and/or bash
  • Experience working within SCIFs

  • IT Security and Compliance focused mindset

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Public Sector
jobs.location: Denver, CO; Honolulu, HI; Washington, DC
jobs.description:
The goal of a Machine Learning Engineer at Scale is to leverage techniques in the fields of generative AI, computer vision, reinforcement learning, and agentic AI to improve Scale's products and customer experience in production environments. Our machine learning engineers take advantage of robust internal infrastructure and unique access to massive datasets to deliver improvements to our customers.

Our Public Sector Machine Learning team is focused on deploying cutting-edge models to mission-critical government systems through products like Donovan and Thunderforge. Our work spans multiple modalities, with a strong focus on both large language models and computer vision. On the LLM side, we are developing agentic systems that help solve complex operational and planning challenges for government partners. This includes building agent frameworks that integrate with custom retrieval pipelines and production APIs, as well as evaluation tools to benchmark and refine agent behavior. We're also advancing research in areas like reinforcement learning for agentic LLMs, with successful deployment into real-world operational environments. On the computer vision front, we're training advanced models to increase labeling throughput and automate perception tasks. Our efforts include building large-scale fine-tuning pipelines, training models across multiple modalities, and developing generalizable vision foundation models to support a wide range of defense applications.

You will:

  • Take state of the art models developed internally and from the community, use them in production to solve problems for our customers and taskers
  • Improve and maintain production models through retraining, hyperparameter tuning, and architectural updates, while preserving core performance characteristics
  • Collaborate with product and research teams to identify and prototype ML-driven product enhancements, including for upcoming product lines
  • Work with massive datasets to develop both generic models as well as fine tune models for specific products
  • Build scalable machine learning infrastructure to automate and optimize our ML services
  • Serve as a cross-functional representative and advocate for machine learning techniques across engineering and product organizations
  • Be comfortable learning new technologies quickly and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Comfortable with light travel (approximately 10%) for customer interaction and team needs

This role will require an active TS security clearance

  • 2+ years of experience building and deploying applied ML systems in production envir

jobs.title: Machine Learning Fellow - Human Frontier Collective
jobs.description:
About the Collective

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think.
We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who should apply

  • Background: PhD, or postdoctoral research experience, in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field; or senior industry experience in Machine Learning or a related field.
  • Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and MLOps tools (Docker) and LLM frameworks (LangChain) is a plus.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion for applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force.

Scale's Machine Learning Research team builds the foundation for the next generation of AI systems — pushing the boundaries of what's possible with frontier models while ensuring safety, reliability, and alignment at every step. Our work spans generative AI, reinforcement learning and advanced post-training methods, scalable oversight, synthetic data pipelines, red teaming, and evaluation science.

We are developing a large-scale hybrid human-machine system to power machine learning pipelines for dozens of industry-leading customers. These models and systems form the backbone of Scale's long-term strategy, enabling billions of tasks monthly and supporting some of the most complex and advanced use cases in the AI ecosystem.

As an intern, you'll work on a combination of deeply technical ML applications in production and cutting-edge research problems, with mentorship from world-class researchers and the opportunity to collaborate with leading teams across industry and academia. Interns own real, published or shipped work — not side projects.

Example Projects

  • Measure the dangerous capabilities of frontier models and conduct preparedness research
  • Research the science and creation of new benchmarks for frontier models
  • Develop new methods for training models to excel on extremely difficult reasoning problems that require long chains of thought
  • Research reinforcement learning and post-training methods that improve model reliability on high-stakes tasks
  • Research scalable oversight protocols that enable humans to produce and quality control reasoning chains beyond their native capabilities
  • Study the boundaries of model generalization and capabilities to inform data-driven advancements
  • Research synthetic and hybrid data with humans in the loop to scale up high-quality data generation
  • Take models currently in production, identify areas for improvement, improve them using retraining and hyperparameter searches, then deploy without regressing on core model characteristics
  • Create post-training or agentic solutions that integrate into our ability to deliver applications for enterprise and public sector clients

Required to Have

  • Currently enrolled in a BS, MS or PhD program with a focus on Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or Natural Language Processing, with a graduation date in Fall 2

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Scientist, Evaluations
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Scale works with the industry's leading AI labs to provide high quality data and accelerate progress in GenAI research. We are looking for Research Scientists and Research Engineers with expertise in LLM post-training (SFT, RLHF, reward modeling) and evaluation. This role is on the evaluation pod within the GenAI Research Organization and will focus on building benchmarks and diagnosing model failure modes in both text and multimodal modalities.

In this role, you will develop rigorous evaluations and diagnostic methods that reveal where frontier models fail and why. You will collaborate with researchers and engineers to define best practices in evaluation-driven AI development. You will also partner with top foundation model labs to translate failure analysis into technical and strategic input on the next generation of generative AI models.

You will:

  • Analyze model behavior to identify, characterize, and diagnose failure modes in frontier LLMs and Agents. You’ll identify everything from capability gaps and reasoning errors to robustness and alignment issues, all focusing on RCA.
  • Design and build benchmarks and evaluation methods that measure LLM capabilities in both text and multimodal modalities.
  • Apply post-training expertise (SFT, RLHF, reward modeling) to connect observed failures to the data and training interventions that address them.
  • Publish research findings in top-tier AI conferences.

Ideally you’d have:

  • Ph.D. or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field.
  • Deep understanding of deep learning, reinforcement learning, and large-scale model fine-tuning.
  • Experience with post-training techniques such as RLHF, preference modeling, or instruction tuning, and with LLM evaluation or benchmark development.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Published research in areas of machine learning at major conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR, etc.) and/or journals.
  • Previous experience in a customer facing role.

Scale is uniquely positioned at the heart of the field of AI as an indispensable provider of training and evaluation data and end-to-end solutions for the ML lifecycle. You will work closely across Scale’s ML teams and researchers to build the foundation platform that supports all our ML research and development. jobs.title: Product Manager, Enterprise Core Platform
jobs.location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
Role Summary

Scale is building the agentic operating system that powers AI deployment across the world's most important organizations. The Platform PM is the person who determines what that foundation needs to be — and holds the bar on how well it gets built.

This is not a roadmap PM, a program manager, or a feature tracker. The Platform PM owns the core infrastructure that every FD team builds on top of: defining the foundation before anything else can be built reliably, sequencing work against real customer commitments and FD team velocity, identifying which FD-built patterns are ready to graduate to core, and ensuring that every capability that ships does so at a bar customers can trust without thinking about it.

The best Platform PMs have defined platform capabilities at production bar in high-stakes environments and understand the difference between what is necessary to build, what is interesting to build, and what should never be built at all.

What You'll Do

  • Define the foundation. Determine what needs to be true at the core platform layer — across each capability pillar — before anything reliable can be built on top of it.
  • Sequence it. Prioritize and order platform work given customer commitments, FD team velocity needs, and what is actually blocking progress today. Getting this wrong means building on an unstable base or building the right things in the wrong order and paying for it in rework and FD team drag.
  • Identify patterns and graduate capabilities. Watch what FD teams are building across the application layer, determine what is genuinely repeating, and make the call on what moves to core — and when. Do not rush graduation or delay it out of caution.
  • Hold the quality bar. Every capability on the platform roadmap earns its place twice: once by being necessary, and again by being done well enough that customers trust it without thinking about it. Keep the platform from becoming a graveyard of half-built capabilities.
  • Unlock delivery team time to value. Forward deployed delivery teams should spend their time solving the hardest customer problems, not rebuilding plumbing on every engagement. That requires a platform that is secure by default, deployable anywhere, observable in production, and equipped with the agentic primitives, eval infrastructure, expert judgment capture, and data reasoning capabilities that every agent workload needs.
  • Partner across the organization. Work closely with platform engineering, forward deployed PMs, and BU leads to surface signal, resolve sequencing tradeoffs, and keep the roadmap grounded in what is actually blocking work.

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 6+ years in product management with meaningful time owning platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products at production bar.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, AI Safety and Alignment
jobs.description:
Scale Labs, Research Scientist — AI Safety and Alignment

As the leading data and evaluation partner for frontier AI companies, Scale plays a central role in understanding and safeguarding AI systems. Building on this expertise, Scale Labs has launched a new team focused on technical AI safety and policy research, to bridge the gap between frontier AI research and policy, helping policymakers make informed, evidence-based decisions about AI capabilities and risks.

Our research tackles some of the hardest open problems in AI safety: assessing the alignment of frontier models, developing control protocols and monitoring methods, preserving the monitorability, understanding failure modes in multi-agent systems and recursive self-improvement. We collaborate closely with partners across industry, the public sector, and academia and regularly publish our findings. We are looking for talented researchers to join us in shaping this vision.

As a Research Scientist on this team, you will conduct research and build evaluations, tools, and datasets that help us understand and reduce risks from frontier AI systems. For example, you might do any or all of the following:

  • Design and stress-test control protocols and monitoring systems that detect and limit unsafe behavior by AI models and agents in deployment;
  • Build alignment evaluations that probe for deception, sabotage, scheming, reward hacking, and other misaligned behaviors;
  • Study monitorability, including whether a model’s reasoning stays faithful and legible enough to supervise, and how training methods and deployment practices can preserve or erode it;
  • Investigate risks that emerge when multiple AI agents interact, such as collusion, coordination failures and steerability;
  • Develop threat models and evaluations for AI systems that automate AI research and development, to track progress toward recursive self-improvement and inform preparedness planning;
  • Work with government agencies and other labs to scope and design evaluations that measure and mitigate risks from advanced AI;
  • Publish research and evaluation methodologies, and write technical reports for policymakers.

Ideally you’d have:

  • Commitment to our mission of promoting safe, secure, and trustworthy AI as capabilities continue to advance.
  • Practical experience conducting technical research collaboratively. You should be comfortable building and instrumenting ML pipelines, building evaluation harnesses, running experiments on frontier models and agents, and quickly turning new ideas from the research literature into working prototypes.

About the role

As Revenue Operations Manager for Enterprise GTM, you will own the measurement layer of our go-to-market engine. You will be the key to what is in the pipeline, what is converting, what is slipping, and, most importantly, why, and the . Your primary customers are our enterprise new logo and expansion teams across healthcare and life sciences, financial and professional services, TMT and energy, and public sector.

We treat go-to-market as an engineered system. Architecture and design sit with the Director you report to. Instrumentation, measurement, and diagnosis sit with you.

What you'll do

  • Establish a single agreed definition for every core metric (pipeline created, qualified pipeline, coverage multiple, win rate, cycle time, ACV, committed vs. consumed) and defend it. One number, one source, one definition.
  • Report bookings, recognized revenue, and consumption as the distinct measures they are, and make the bridge between them legible to people who do not live in the model.
  • Run the operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast calls in Salesforce and Clari, MBRs, QBRs, and the enterprise section of board reporting.
  • Build stakeholder-specific, self-serve views so vertical leaders, sales development, and partnerships can answer their own routine questions without opening a ticket with you.

Turn the data into insight

  • Answer the hard "why" questions, e.g., why Stage 3 conversion dropped in financial services, which sourcing motions produce the highest-ACV enterprise deals, where multi-year agreements stall in legal review.
  • Build leading indicators and early-warning triggers so leadership sees a coverage or velocity problem 60 days out rather than in the last week of the quarter.
  • Pressure-test the forecast. Deliver an independent bottoms-up call and be willing to disagree with the field's number in front of senior leaders.
  • Diagnose where to reallocate capacity, headcount, and pipeline generation effort across verticals, and bring the recommendation, not just the chart.
  • Produce the analysis behind strategic bets: segmentation changes, territory restructuring, pricing and packaging shifts, new vertical entry.

Instrument the funnel and the systems that feed it

  • Own top-of-funnel reporting for Sales Development: lead conversion loops, sourced vs. influenced pipeline, meeting-to-opportunity rates, and adherence to the

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the role

Scale's Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you'll own the AI behaviour of production systems our clients depend on, including the agents, evaluations, and backend integration behind them. You'll lead delivery for your workstream and act as the technical point of contact for clients on how their AI performs on live data.

What you'll do

  • Own the AI layer of production systems for public sector clients, including agents, model integration, and the backend services they run on
  • Build production agents from established architectural patterns, with reliable tool calling, guardrails, and observability
  • Select and adapt established evaluation methods, and design new evaluations for client-specific risks
  • Apply context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, model adaptation, or inference optimisation
  • Investigate regressions in the systems you own, lead root-cause analysis, and implement preventative changes
  • Lead project planning for your workstream and manage client expectations on scope, risk, and delivery
  • Codify recurring client work into reusable tooling, evaluation components, or guidance that other engineers adopt
  • Mentor engineers through code review, pairing, and delegated ownership

What we look for

  • Backend engineering experience, with a track record of taking AI/ML systems into production and keeping them reliable
  • Ownership of the AI behaviour of a production system end to end, rather than delivering a component scoped by another team
  • Hands-on evaluation design that ties model behaviour to real-world outcomes, used to catch regressions
  • Comfort working directly with clients, including explaining model behaviour and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Practical knowledge of handling regulated or sensitive data and designing for auditability; sovereign or on-premise deployment experience is valuable
  • Experience leading root-cause analysis on production AI or ML systems

Where this role sits

Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Senior Full-Stack Engineers own the complete user-facing application and its infrastructure. ML Research Engineers lead novel agent architecture and the benchmark methodology used across accounts. The roles work together on agents and evaluation, with accountability set by the scope of the problem.

Software is eating the world, but AI is eating software. We live in unprecedented times – AI has the potential to exponentially augment human intelligence. Every person will have a personal tutor, coach, assistant, personal shopper, travel guide, and therapist throughout life. jobs.description:
About Scale AI

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact.

Scale Frontier Data is the organization behind the training and evaluation data that frontier labs depend on. We build the systems, tooling, and expert workflows that turn hard human expertise into signals that models can learn from, across reasoning, coding, agentic tool use, and domain expertise.

Reinforcement learning environments are now the center of gravity for that work: the difference between a model that demos well and a model that reliably completes long-horizon work is almost always the quality of the environments and reward signals it was trained against.

Responsibilities

As a Staff Software Engineer, RL Environments, you'll own the technical foundation for how Scale builds, runs, verifies, and delivers RL environments at scale.

An RL environment is a real piece of software: a containerized world with real dependencies, real state, real tools, and a grader that has to be correct even when the agent is creative about breaking it. Building one is a full-stack engineering problem. Building thousands of them reproducibly, cheaply, with trustworthy reward signals and throughput measured in millions of rollouts is a systems problem that very few people have solved.

You'll work on both. You'll design the platform: sandboxed execution, environment packaging and versioning, rollout orchestration, trajectory capture, verifier frameworks, and the authoring surfaces that let engineers and domain experts produce environments without reinventing infrastructure each time. And you'll go deep on the environments themselves by instrumenting real applications, designing task suites that expose specific capability gaps, and building graders that hold up under adversarial optimization.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll set technical direction across multiple teams, and you'll still be the person who writes the hard part.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals in distributed systems, system design, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Strong Python skills and a track record of shipping production software; comfort in at least one other part of the stack (TypeScript/React, Go, Rust, or similar).
  • Deep experience with containerization and sandboxed execution, including Docker, VMs, gVisor/Firecracker, Kubernetes, or equivalent.
  • Experience building or operating high-throughput backend systems: orchestration, job scheduling, queuing, and large-scale data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs including agent loops, tool calling, MCP,

jobs.title: Senior Customer Analyst
jobs.description:
At Dexory, we're developing advanced software powered by cutting-edge robots that are transforming the very face of global logistics. With infectious enthusiasm, our unique blend of disciplines work in harmony to produce results at pace. From hardware and manufacturing to software, AI and commercial, we're one team – one heart – that beats, learns and grows together.

Take your customer analysis out of the dashboard and onto the warehouse floor.

As an experienced Senior Customer Analyst you already know how to find the story in customer data: segments, drivers of churn, usage patterns, voice-of-customer signals. Here, you'll pair that with what you see first-hand in live warehouses, then use both to decide which product bets Dexory makes.

What you'll do

  • Get to the "why" behind the numbers. Run contextual inquiry, operator and manager interviews, surveys, card sorts, and prototype and usability tests across every stage of deployment and every persona.
  • Check site behaviour against behaviour at scale. Combine what you observe on site with Pendo and DexoryView usage data, so no insight rests on one warehouse or one dashboard.
  • Validate or kill ideas quickly. Pressure-test concepts with A/B tests, prototype tests and interviews, and tell the team whether a bet solves a real problem.
  • Close the loop after go-live. Log structured operator and site-manager feedback, pass it to the PM, and keep it in the research repository.
  • Size the opportunity. Support market sizing and competitive mapping for specific themes.
  • Turn findings into decisions. Write clear, presentation-ready syntheses and share them through Notion and Slack, internally and externally.
  • Run the insight machinery. Maintain SurveyMonkey dashboards, co-maintain the research insights pipeline, and feed capacity and progress data into the shared operating dashboard.
  • Shape how we work with AI. Co-design the AI enablement playbook for research, covering workflows, prompts, guardrails, and what stays human-only versus human-in-the-loop.
  • Give the user a voice. Co-develop UX content with the Lead and Commercial team.

What you'll bring

  • 2-4 years in research, qual/quant insight, or product/bet design
  • Solid grounding in qualitative and quantitative methods, and the judgement to know which one a question needs
  • Comfort with ambiguity, from open question through to early product bet
  • Fluency with tools like Notion, SurveyMonkey, Slack, Pendo and Basecamp
  • Strong written and verbal synthesis
  • Field experience in warehouses, logistics, manufacturing, healthcare operations or similar, and comfort on a war

You'll partner across Design, Animation, and Engineering to prototype abilities, define visual language hierarchies, and create reusable systems that support thousands of effects across characters, environments, and interactions.

  • Collaborate with Tech Art and Engineering to profile effects and define practical performance and scalability targets for open world spaces and different quality settings.
  • Represent VFX in cross-discipline reviews and planning - communicating tradeoffs, guiding adoption of the visual standards, and helping unblock teams without implying that this role alone owns technical architecture or people management.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience creating real-time VFX for AAA games.

  • Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, readability, and prioritization in complex gameplay spaces.
  • Experience with modular and systemic VFX development, creating reusable effects that scale across large environments.
  • Familiarity with performance optimization for large scale battles and high density environments.
  • Experience shipping at least one AAA game title.

dich vor der Kamera wohlfühlst, klar sprichst und natürlich wirkst – das ist für diese Stelle Pflicht

ein Gespür dafür hast, was in den ersten Sekunden eines Videos passieren muss

zuverlässig bist und gern mit dem Team in unserem Kölner Office arbeitest

sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mitbringst

ein eigener Kanal oder erste Erfahrung mit UGC oder Werbevideos

erste Erfahrung mit KI-Tools für Video, Bild oder Stimme
