jobs.title: 3D Character Artist - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Character Artist at Riot, you will bring champions to life by creating and texturing high and low poly models. You will help craft some of the most iconic characters in the world of gaming. Your sculpting skills, artistic eye and keen understanding of anatomy, form, and color will lead the way in character creation. Working within both technical and design constraints, you will use your knowledge of proportions, anatomy and readability to ensure models are optimized in game. Your craft expertise, high-level execution and attention to detail will enrich the player’s immersive experience.

As a 3D Character Artist on the Unpublished R&D Product, you will translate character concepts into game-ready assets that meet technical and design requirements. You will contribute throughout the character production process, from concept to final implementation, and collaborate with multiple disciplines and external partners to deliver consistently high-quality character assets. Responsibilities:

  • Use your knowledge of stylized character art to create high-quality 3D character models.

jobs.title: Anti-Cheat Engineering Intern (Masters/PhD) - Summer 2027
jobs.description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is passionate about protecting the integrity of multiplayer games and creating a fair experience for players. We work across low-level systems, software protection, and security research to help protect the legitimacy of players’ games.

As an Anti-Cheat Engineering Intern, you’ll work with experienced Vanguard engineers on a summer research project exploring how agentic AI is changing the effectiveness of software obfuscation and virtualization. With mentorship from the team, you’ll use and improve research harnesses that iteratively challenge code-protection techniques, measure the boundaries of AI-assisted reverse engineering, and investigate methods for making protected code more resilient to AI analysis. You’ll turn your findings into repeatable experiments, clear technical documentation, and make recommendations that inform the future of Anti-Cheat and client software protection.

Potential Responsibilities:

  • Work with Anti-Cheat engineers to scope and complete a bounded research project focused on AI-assisted analysis of obfuscated and virtualized code.
  • Build and improve AI harnesses that iteratively improve and challenge code-protection techniques to study the boundaries of their design
  • Design and run experiments that measure where AI systems succeed, struggle, or fail when reasoning about protected binaries.
  • Research and evaluate techniques that make software obfuscation and virtualization more resilient to AI-assisted reverse engineering.
  • Reproduce and validate results, documenting experimental methods, evidence, limitations, and potential defensive implications.
  • Contribute improvements to shared research tools and workflows, and present progress and findings to engineers and technical partners.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in a Masters or Doctoral program in the following fields: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related graduate degree program.
  • Experience programming in C or C++, demonstrated through coursework, research, internships, or personal projects.
  • Experience with agentic AI tools or harnesses used to automate iterative workflows such as code generation, testing, analysis, or evaluation.
  • Foundational understanding and relevant coursework in operating systems, computer architecture, compilers, and software security.
  • Available to work full-time hours for the 12-week program.
  • Minimum GPA of 2.5.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Graduating in the 2028 calendar year.
  • Exposure to reverse engineering, binary analysis, code obfuscation, software virtualization, or related security techniques through coursework or hands-on projects.
  • Experience with Python, scripting, Git, testing, or building repeatable research and evaluation tools.

Our Site Leads direct their teams in driving technical triage, developing systems for incident mitigation, and creating solutions to reduce incidents across all current and future Riot games.

You will develop and lead a team of technical sleuths that can accelerate finding the source and the dependencies of any problem at Riot.

You’re right for this role if the idea of growing a new kind of engineering team at Riot and coaching engineers to succeed excites you. You believe SRE is a valuable role you play, not a title you are given. You know in your bones that triage, problem identification, and early detection are essential engineering skills, and you want to teach them to others. You cultivate relationships to provide your team with the support it needs to execute and grow. You use iterative approaches to problems and know how to compromise between ideal solutions and practical outcomes. You believe that just because something is hard doesn’t mean it isn’t worth doing.

  • Ensure the Site’s engineers receive active mentorship to develop their technical and soft skills

  • Manage the Site’s capacity for project work and incident response, and drive and report on site performance metrics

Reporting to the Technical Art Manager, you will ensure that assets meet technical performance standards and artistic direction requirements. In collaboration with Art, Design, Engineering, and external partners, you will contribute to production support and workflow improvements.

Please note that Riot Games does not offer relocation packages for this position.

Responsibilities:

  • Apply strong PBR fundamentals across albedo, normal, roughness, metallic, ambient occlusion, emissive, lighting, and reflection-probe inputs, ensuring shader features account for the full material response rather than the diffuse channel in isolation.
  • Collaborate directly with Art and Design to understand desired visual behaviors and art direction, and translate them into clear, achievable, and performant rendering solutions.
  • Provide hands-on technical support to internal and external vendor artists, helping them author, integrate, and troubleshoot materials and shaders for Epic and Legendary skins.

jobs.title: Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
jobs.description:
Riot Anti-Cheat Engineers are versatile and passionate about their craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer, you will be responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s client services. With versatility across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling services, you’ll work primarily in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly to build new anti-cheat features, improve the security and reliability of existing systems, and debug complex behavior across the Windows stack. You’ll also reverse engineer emerging cheats, including packed and obfuscated binaries, and rapidly translate those findings into practical detections, mitigations, and preventative controls. You'll be based in our Santa Monica, CA office and work in a hybrid (work-from-home and in-office) environment. You'll report to the Sr. Manager of Anti-Cheat Engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and drive high impact anti-cheat features from ambiguity to production across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling surfaces
  • Move fast to turn emerging threats into resilient detections or preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed with agility at scale.
  • Think ahead to design and develop capabilities that anticipate the cheaters next move or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
  • Reverse engineer highly evasive cheats and operating system manipulation techniques
  • Investigate and resolve complex compatibility issues in highly opaque environments
  • Support game teams directly in understanding cheating ecosystems and integrating Anti-Cheat

Required Qualifications:

  • Proficient in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly
  • Experience building and debugging low-level, security-sensitive systems
  • Strong understanding of Windows process internals, including process and thread lifecycles, virtual memory, handles and objects, security contexts, executable image formats, DLL loading, and the Windows loader
  • Hands-on reverse engineering experience, including analyzing packed, protected, or obfuscated binaries and identifying techniques used to conceal or manipulate runtime behavior
  • Practical understanding of the Windows kernel and driver model, with demonstrated experience developing, debugging, and maintaining production grade kernel-mode drivers.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience within cheat-development or game-security research communities, with practical knowledge of modern cheat techniques

Environment Design

Design Systems & Methodology

  • 构建场景设计逻辑，包括空间布局、视觉语言、设计原则及叙事关联。
  • 建立并持续完善场景设计规范，包括尺度体系、模块化原则、细节密度及视觉引导等。

Spatial Design & Collaboration

  • 设计清晰的视觉引导与空间层级，提升整体体验及信息传达效率。

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • 持续跟进场景从概念到最终实现的整体质量。

Quality

  • 根据产品需求及目标平台要求，平衡设计复杂度与制作成本。
  • 在探索阶段提供多方向设计方案，快速支持设计迭代。

  • 开发和推动面向动画制作与效率工具、调试流程方案，帮助团队更高质量、更高效率地完成内容实现

  • 熟悉 Maya 绑定工作流程与相关功能使用，理解角色绑定与动画系统的基础实现逻辑

jobs.description:

jobs.description:
As UX Designers at Riot, we are responsible for design work in high-scope product areas that are complex and ambiguous. Our work includes end-to-end experience design. The spaces will generally encompass multiple features and span across teams. We work from concept through development and collaborate with other designers to achieve our goals.

As a UX Designer on Wild Rift, you will be responsible for the UX design of in-game events and parts of the Around Game player experience. You will help turn patch and product goals into clear, engaging, and shippable player experiences. You will also improve selected Around Game systems, with particular attention to core gameplay and primary player flows.

You will work self-directed with minimal oversight on known tasks, make local product decisions within your space, and begin to participate in product direction. You will advocate for the player experience while accounting for the needs of multiple audiences and cross-functional partners.

jobs.title: 中国区周边消费品业务销售运营经理 (Contract)
jobs.description:
拳头游戏（Riot Games）由一群富有创业精神的硬核玩家于2006年创立。我们坚信“玩家优先”的理念能够造就伟大的游戏。我们的首款游戏《英雄联盟》（League of Legends）于2009年发行，赢得了业界与玩家的广泛赞誉。如今，它已成为全球最受欢迎的电子游戏之一，月活跃玩家超过一亿。

在拳头游戏，玩家是我们一切工作的核心。我们正在寻找谦逊、充满雄心且目光敏锐的专业人才，你们不仅要对游戏满怀热情，还要敢于打破常规。作为回报，我们将为你提供充满挑战且全力支持的成长环境。

关于该职位 作为业务运营经理，你将直接向消费品业务运营负责人汇报，并成为我们在B2B商业版图上的核心驱动力。你将扮演至关重要的桥梁角色，将拳头游戏的高品质IP周边与我们的战略线下及B2B合作伙伴紧密连接。

你的核心使命主要分为三个方面：积极拓展B2B网络，获取全新的大客户；深入管理并发展现有的战略合作关系；全盘负责我们线下体验式零售活动的商业闭环（如电竞快闪店和粉丝嘉年华）。你是一位谈判专家和关系建立大师，深知在游戏IP领域，成功的B2B战略绝不仅仅是单纯的“卖货”，而是在现实世界中为我们的玩家创造触手可及、高品质的体验触点。

核心职责

  • 大客户拓展（B2B商务拓展）： 发掘、宣讲并引入新的战略级B2B合作伙伴、线下零售连锁店及垂直领域经销商。开拓与拳头游戏高端品牌定位相符的全新线下销售渠道。
  • 现有KA覆盖与增长： 维护并深化与现有大客户（如腾讯、大型线下零售网络）的合作关系。负责商业条款谈判、管控批发利润率，并确保健康的库存消化率，从而达成年度B2B营收目标。
  • 线下活动与体验式零售： 主导线下周边体验的端到端商业落地。包括在LPL总决赛、VCT巡回赛、拳头游戏周年庆及专属快闪店等重大节点中，全面管理现场销售运营、库存把控及合作伙伴协调。
  • B2B战略与规划： 与销售运营负责人紧密合作，制定年度和季度的B2B销售策略，确保其与我们更广泛的DTP（玩家直营）/电商目标相辅相成。
  • 合作伙伴营销与联合推广： 与外部KA伙伴及内部营销团队协同，设计定制化的零售营销活动，确保我们的实体产品在合作伙伴的生态系统中获得最大化的曝光。
  • 数据追踪与汇报： 监控B2B渠道健康度、合作伙伴合规性以及线下活动的投资回报率（ROI）。提供定期的销售预测与具备实操性的洞察分析，以持续优化线下业务。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 8年以上B2B销售、大客户管理或渠道商务拓展经验；拥有消费品、潮玩或娱乐IP行业经验者优先。
  • 扎实的BD业绩： 能够证明自己具备开拓新市场、谈判复杂分销合同，以及从零搭建盈利性B2B渠道的能力。
  • 线下活动运营： 具备线下零售运营、快闪店或大型活动/展会商业展台操盘的实战经验。
  • 利益相关方管理： 出色的跨部门/跨企业沟通技巧，能够影响并管理顶级经销商以及内部跨职能团队（如供应链、营销、IP授权等）。
  • 敏捷性与问题解决能力： 适应快节奏的工作环境，乐于挽起袖子亲力亲为，能够迅速解决线下活动现场的突发运营问题。
  • 沟通能力： 具备出色的中英文口头与书面沟通及商业谈判能力。

加分项（期待条件）

  • 在中国核心的线下潮玩/收藏品零售商、书店、院线或生活方式分销网络中拥有深厚的人脉资源与现有合作关系。
  • 对游戏充满真挚的热爱，并对《英雄联盟》、《无畏契约》（VALORANT）或《云顶之弈》（TFT）的玩家文化有深刻理解。

在这个岗位上，你的成功将源于精湛的专业技能、团队协作精神，以及始终将“给玩家带来惊喜”置于首位的决策力。我们不仅会考量你的过往学业与经验，还会看重你与游戏的个人羁绊。如果你具备玩家同理心，并深切关怀玩家的体验，这就是为你量身定制的角色！

用工性质：与专业人事服务公司FESCO Adecco签订劳动合同

jobs.title: 技术美术，渲染 - Unpublished R&D Product (Contract)
jobs.description:
作为一名渲染技术美术师，你的主要职责是支持美术团队进行美术资产原型开发，使他们能够在游戏中实现创作。你将与所有美术部门的艺术家合作，从角色、场景、特效到灯光，确保资产符合技术管线的要求。你将与各个艺术部门紧密协作，参与标准化并优化游戏内资产、材质、着色器和可扩展开发管线的生产流程。

在研发部门担任渲染技术美术师，你将向技术美术负责人汇报，并与技术美术、美术和程序团队合作，构建支持游戏美术风格的材质和着色器。你还将参与灯光和资产优化，同时通过开发工具和管线为美术人员提供支持，帮助他们改进工作流程，减少技术障碍和低效环节。在具备渲染基础的同时，若你在 UE5 Niagara 或 UI 技术美术方向有相关经验，将会是加分项。

职责：

  • 维护和制作角色、场景、特效的 Shader 和材质库，支持高质量渲染效果的实现
  • 研究风格化及写实渲染流程，协助优化光照及后处理效果，提升整体视觉表现
  • 参与渲染管线的定制与优化，负责材质及美术资产的性能优化，并使用 profiling 工具进行分析
  • 跟进 UE5 渲染新特性，并在项目中进行合理应用
  • 与美术、程序团队协作，确保渲染方案能够有效落地

岗位要求：

  • 有游戏项目开发经验
  • 3 年及以上相关工作经验
  • 熟悉 UE5 渲染，掌握 HLSL、Unreal Material Editor，具备材质开发与优化经验
  • 熟悉 DCC 工具及资产制作流程，如 Maya、Photoshop、Substance Designer/Painter
  • 对实时光照、着色模型、后处理或风格化渲染有良好理解
  • 具备一定的性能优化经验，熟悉 RenderDoc、Unreal Profiler 等工具的基本使用

加分项：

  • 熟悉 UE5 Niagara 系统（特效制作或性能优化）
  • 有 UI 技术美术相关经验（UMG、UI 材质或 UI 性能优化等）
  • 具备 LookDev 经验，理解色彩理论、相机语言
  • 有完整游戏项目上线经验

在提交申请时，请提供作品集或Demo Reel，你可能被要求完成艺术测试。

对于这个岗位，你将通过工艺专业知识、协作精神以及优先考虑玩家乐趣的决策来获得成功。我们将关注您过去的学习、经验以及您与游戏的个人关系。如果您体现了玩家的同理心并关心玩家的体验，这可能就是您的角色！

jobs.title: Offre de stage :  Imprimer l'énergie de demain : développement de générateurs thermoélectriques innovants
jobs.description:
Unité : CERI MP

Responsables : Dr. CHARLON Sébastien, Pr. SAMUEL Cédric, Dr. Amulya RAJ

Nature de l’emploi : Stage de master 2 ou équivalent d’une durée de 6 mois

Lieu de travail : Douai (59)

Description de l’IMT Nord Europe :

École sous tutelle du ministère de l’économie, des finances et de la souveraineté industrielle et numérique, IMT Nord Europe est née en 2017 de la fusion de Télécom Lille et de l’École des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd’hui parmi les plus Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 élèves, dont un quart d’apprentis, plus de 600 diplômés par an et un réseau de 15 000 diplômés. Elle fait partie de l’Institut Mines Télécom, premier groupe public de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l’université de Lille.  IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ingénieurs responsables aptes à résoudre les grandes problématiques du XXIème siècle ; mener des recherches débouchant sur des innovations à haute valeur ajoutée ; soutenir le développement des territoires notamment en facilitant l’innovation et les créations d’entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ingénieurs de demain, maîtrisant à la fois les technologies numériques et les savoir-faire industriels. Idéalement située au carrefour de l’Europe, à 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l’ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, numériques et environnementales du XXIème siècle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l’ingénieur et les technologies du digital.  Localisée sur 2 sites principaux d’enseignement et de recherche, à Lille et à Douai, IMT Nord Europe s’appuie sur plus de 20 000 m² de laboratoire pour développer un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d’excellence dans les trois domaines « Systèmes Numériques », « Energie Environnement » et « Matériaux et Procédés ».  Pour plus de détails, consulter le site internet de l’École :

www.imt-nord-europe.fr

Contexte scientifique et missions  :

Le développement de capteurs autonomes en énergie pour l'Internet des objets (IoT) représente un défi scientifique et technologique majeur. Dans ce contexte, les technologies de récupération d'énergie constituent des solutions prometteuses pour convertir différentes sources d'énergie présentes dans notre environnement (mécanique, thermique, solaire, électromagnétique, etc.) en énergie électrique.  Le projet européen  THERMOHARV , réunissant l'Université de Mons, l'Université de Lille, le C2DE et l’IMT Nord Europe, ambitionne de développer une nouvelle génération de  microgénérateurs thermoélectriques organiques (OTEG), flexibles et performants , capables de convertir directement la chaleur fatale en énergie électrique. Ces dispositifs pourraient notamment contribuer à l'alimentation de capteurs autonomes dans les bâtiments, les centres de données ou les environnements industriel

jobs.title: Senior Deal Desk Manager
jobs.description:
JOB OVERVIEW

The Senior Deal Desk Manager is a senior individual contributor role responsible for how  Legion  prices, structures, approves, and contracts global deals across every region Legion sells into. Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, this person will take a Deal Desk that already has a foundation and scale it into a fast, compliant, AI-native function — through better systems and automation, not more headcount.

The ideal candidate has built Deal Desk operations from scratch at an early-stage or growth-stage SaaS company and knows what to standardize, what to automate, and what to leave flexible. They work AI-first: when a process is slow, their first move is to build an agent, a tool, or an automation. This person will serve as the connective tissue between Sales, Finance, Legal, and Client Management, helping to streamline quote-to-close workflows, enforce pricing governance, and accelerate revenue realization.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Own deal structuring for complex new business, expansion, and renewal deals, partnering with sales leaders on creative structures that protect margin and policy.

Own the approval matrix, discount guardrails, non-standard terms policy, and SLAs, with accountability for approval cycle time and quote accuracy.

Support global deals end to end, including multi-currency pricing, multiple contracting entities, regional terms and tax considerations, and approval cycles that span time zones.

Partner with Legal and Finance on contract standards, regional contracting requirements (data protection terms, local entity paper, currency/FX policy), revenue recognition alignment, and the order-to-cash handoff.

Design Deal Desk workflows with AI at the core — for example, automated deal pre-screening against pricing and packaging policy, AI-generated deal summaries for approvers, and AI-assisted redline review against Legal’s playbook.

Build and iterate working tools — pricing calculators, quoting tools, and approval automations — using AI-assisted development.

Set guardrails for AI in deal workflows, including human-in-the-loop approvals, appropriate data handling, and a clear audit trail.

Own and evolve Legion’s quoting and contracting stack (CPQ, CLM, DocuSign) with Salesforce as the system of record, including tools built in-house, and ensure workflows handle currencies, entities, and regional templates without manual workarounds.

Develop reporting and dashboards that give Sales, Finance, and executive leadership visibility into discount trends, packaging adherence, approval turnaround times, and the impact of automation.

Present deal analysis and insights directly in executive pricing reviews and forecast discussions.

Partner closely with RevOps, Product Marketing, and Finance to operationalize pricing and packaging changes. Build the deal calculators, edge-case rules, and sales playbooks that bring new pricing to life in the field.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

8+ years of experience

jobs.title: AI Researcher
jobs.description:
Hume AI  is seeking talented AI researchers interested in working with our team to build state-of-the-art speech-language models (SLMs). Our new SLM training method—reinforcement learning from human expression (RLHE)—learns human preferences from behavior in millions of audio and video recordings, making SLMs superhumanly helpful, interesting, funny, eloquent, honest, and altruistic. Join us in the heart of New York City and contribute to our endeavor to ensure that AI is guided by human values, the most pivotal challenge (and opportunity) of the 21st century.

About Us

Hume AI is a Series B startup dedicated to building artificial intelligence that is directly optimized for human well-being. As the first company to release speech language models, we’re focused on expanding our research to encompass audio understanding models and evaluation platforms for enterprises.

Our goal is to enable a future in which technology draws on an understanding of human emotional expression to better serve human goals. As part of our mission, we also conduct groundbreaking scientific research, publish in leading scientific journals like  Nature , and support a non-profit, The Hume Initiative, that has released the first concrete ethical guidelines for empathic AI ( www.thehumeinitiative.org ). You can learn more about us on our website ( https://hume.ai/ ) and read about us in  WIRED ,  Forbes , and  Venturebeat .

About the Role

We are looking for talented researchers with relevant publications, 2+ years of experience in a research role in industry, and/or a proven track record of contributions to open source language, audio, or video models. (A PhD is neither necessary nor sufficient.) We're looking for someone excited to work with our team to build state-of-the-art audio models and evaluation tools. In this role, you will build out software systems that support distributed model training, inference, and benchmarking as well as massive-scale data collection, storage, preprocessing, and analysis. You will be working to solve some of today’s most exciting AI research problems at industry scale.

Requirements

Expertise in the Python ecosystem and popular ML libraries and tools (e.g. PyTorch)

Experience writing robust and maintainable production-ready code

Comfort iterating quickly on new and uncertain research directions

2+ years of experience contributing to the training and/or fine-tuning of models with large-scale datasets of text, audio, image, and/or video data (predictive or generative)

Application Note

Please apply only to the position that best aligns with your qualifications. If you submit multiple applications or have applied within the past 6 months, only your initial submission will be considered.

Annual Salary

$180,000—$350,000 USD

As an FPGA Engineer Intern on Harmattan AI’s compute module team, you will take camera aggregation from concept to real hardware for the first time. Final-year Master’s or engineering school student in electrical engineering, electronics or embedded systems.

Previous hands-on experience with FPGAs and digital board design and debugging.

Experience writing software that runs close to the hardware; embedded Linux is a plus.

Hands-on in the lab and comfortable reworking wiring, connectors and test setups to get a system running.

jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. About the Role

As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities.

Responsibilities

Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets.

Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data.

Build jamming estimation capabilities, combining out-of-band spectral sniffing with in-band spatial covariance analysis, and the adaptive logic that drives radar behavior in response.

Contribute radar-derived observables and algorithms that support navigation when GNSS is unavailable.

Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints.

Validate algorithms end-to-end through hardware-in-the-loop bench testing, anechoic chamber campaigns, and real flight conditions, iterating quickly on results.

Work closely with the EW and RF analytics modules to align signal processing development with system-level requirements.

Candidate Requirements

2 to 5 years of confirmed, hands-on experience in radar signal processing, gained in the defense or automotive radar industry preferably.

Solid experience in Signal Processing on radar systems, either FMCW or pulsed, is required; exposure to moving target tracking, ECCM, radar-based navigation, or live/real-time processing is a strong plus.

Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions.

A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight.

Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Scopely is looking for a VFX Artist to join our MARVEL Strike Force team in Mexico City on a hybrid basis!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. Marvel Strike Force is Scopely’s squad-based Hero Collector RPG, featuring heroes and villains across the Marvel Universe.

You will create real-time visual effects in Unity for Heroes, Villains, and Creatures from the Marvel universe. You will work with Tech Artists, Animators, Designers, and Engineers to create industry-leading mobile game visual effects and memorable player experiences

  • Work with the VFX Director and Art Director to help set and push the visual effects quality bar and express storytelling through real-time, in-game visual effects

  • Ability to work with production to ensure the timely completion of animation tasks
  • Ability to work collaboratively with the narrative, design, and art team

What We're Looking For

  • Expert real-time visual effects skills and clear knowledge of visual effects techniques and fundamentals: design, animation, value and color theory
  • Adept at working with shaders
  • Proficiency in creating hand painted textures
  • 5+ years of professional experience creating real-time visual effects for games
  • Some experience with technical implementation and integration of visual effects in Unity
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, interpersonal, and organizational skills
  • Excellent time management and work discipline
  • Online Portfolio demonstrating visual effects skills and technical art skills
  • Experience or curiosity in using AI-supported tools responsibly to improve creative workflows, iteration, and productivity

Bonus Points

  • Proficiency in Maya and Unity preferred
  • Mobile games experience
  • Experience creating visual effects for combat
  • Skilled in creating hand-drawn, flipbook style textures
  • Passion for all elements of comic book characters, animation, camera framing

We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with.

Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:

  • Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space.
  • Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.
  • Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights.
  • User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc.
  • LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes

jobs.title: Computational Biologist
jobs.description:
About Proxima

Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, Yosemite among others.  Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time.  In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions.

Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. Our technology combines proteome-scale structural data with state-of-the-art generative AI foundation models, and coupled with our talented team of scientists and engineers we are uniquely well-positioned to discover and develop a new class of medicines. Come join us!

About You:

Proxima is seeking highly-motivated Computational Biologists interested in building the leading AI-enabled drug discovery platform for novel induced proximity therapeutic modality.  Successful candidates will work closely with the Computational Chemistry, Machine Learning and Application Engineering teams to tap into the wealth of evolutionary, structural and -omics data to unlock the full potential of unified machine learning representations and large-scale geometric deep learning generative models.  Projects may include designing large-scale scientific workflows for mining public and unique in-house data; developing novel systems biology and structural biology computational methods, tools and algorithms; and/or designing, training and fine-tuning best-in-class machine learning models. In our projects we apply induced proximity approaches to some of the most challenging targets considered “undruggable” as well as discover, build and develop novel proximity platforms spanning across multiple targets and disease areas. About us

Omnilex started by building the AI workspace lawyers actually want to use, including the world's first AI-powered legal commentary, a living layer of legal understanding that redefines how lawyers work. In just one year, that product became the daily tool of thousands of legal professionals across Switzerland, Germany, and Liechtenstein, and a leading legal AI workspace in those markets. Now we are using that foundation to build something even bigger: the AI-native law firm. Every case our lawyers solve becomes a productized, AI-native service. Legal capability that scales, compounds, and can be deployed on demand for the next client. With a 4.5M raise, we're scaling this across Europe. You'll be joining a young, passionate, and dynamic team of 19.

The role

You are a lawyer, and you bring your book of relationships with you. You pick up real customer cases and solve them using Omnilex as your weapon. Then you do something almost no lawyer has ever done: you take what you just built and turn it into a productized, AI-native service that the next customer can run on demand.  You own the customer end-to-end. You're the person they call, the person they trust, and the person whose name shows up when the contract gets renewed. The legal teams you work with are some of the most demanding in Europe, and they expect to talk to a lawyer. That's you.

What you will do

Solve the cases

Pick up real customer matters. Do research, drafting, structuring arguments and deliver work product that holds up.

Be the lawyer in the room when a customer hits a wall they cannot get over alone.

Legal-engineer cases into AI-native services

After each case, decompose what you did into reusable building blocks: prompts, workflows, templates, knowledge.

Work with product and engineering to turn those blocks into services any customer can run on Omnilex.

Maintain a portfolio of services you own and iterate with product and engineering until they are as good as the original work.

Be the named lawyer on the account. Senior partners, GCs, and heads of legal deal with you directly.

Convert pilots into multi-year contracts, expand into new practice groups, more seats, and deeper workflows.

Use your existing network to open doors that take Sales months to crack.

What success looks like

A library of AI-native services you authored is in production and used daily by companies.

Customers in your portfolio renewed, expanded, and brought in referrals because of you.

Revenue under your ownership grew meaningfully quarter over quarter.

Who you are

Swiss bar admission with 2 to 6 years of post-qualification experience.

You currently work at a Swiss mid-size firm or boutique and run your own cases. You work directly with clients today, not through a partner.

Portable client relationships: clients or referrers who would follow you, or a concrete plan to build them.

An existing professional network of lawyers, GCs, partners or alum

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Agent Security's mission is to safely increase how much of the world's work agents can do, starting inside Anthropic.

Claude now writes and ships code, runs experiments and acts on people's behalf, for hours at a time. How much more it can take on depends on how safely it can operate. If, in the worst case, an agent misbehaves, Anthropic and the public may bear the consequences. Our mandate is to mitigate this risk, and Anthropic’s mission depends on it.

The Partnerships team pairs security engineers with the teams at Anthropic that build Claude, build agents and rely on agents. Those teams are our partners. When a team wants its agents to do more, we threat model the plan with them and build the controls together. Most of this has no playbook, so we have often created new controls from first principles. The ones that work become part of our toolbox, spread to other teams, and in some cases ship in our products.

We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead this team of security engineers. This is first and foremost a people leadership role. Few have secured agents at scale, especially at a frontier lab, so we don't expect you to have done it. We do expect you to have led security engineering teams, and we care most about how you lead people and reason about security.

This role operates at the frontier. Each model generation, and each new harness, brings new challenges. The number of teams building on agents keeps growing, and partner teams won't always agree with your calls. In return, you will have the chance to directly contribute to making transformative AI go well, which is the heart of our mission.

Key responsibilities

  • Hire, mentor and grow senior and staff security engineers, and raise the bar as the team scales
  • Set the team's investment strategy, deciding which teams get embedded engineers, and for how long, as demand outgrows the team
  • Support the team through high-stakes safety and security calls made under uncertainty and on tight timelines
  • Balance long-term investment in shared controls against partner teams’ immediate asks
  • Deliver large security

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.  The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.  This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

Backend modules, end to end.  Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

The data.  The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

The foundations.  Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

Reliability and security in production.  Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

The architecture, pragmatically.  Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

The engineering bar.  Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work

jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re building the next chapter of AI-native craft and creativity - where craft and technology meet. Our unified platform bridges the gap between AI capabilities and human creativity, and lets professional creatives and designers harness the power of the world’s leading AI models without losing precision, expression, or soul. Together, we’re building tools that help people move faster without sacrificing quality, precision, or craft - a platform where AI supports creativity instead of flattening it.

We’re looking for a scrappy, hands-on AI Product Technical Program Manager to join Figma Weave as the team’s first TPM. You’ll partner with Engineering, Product, and Design to turn ambiguous customer needs and new AI capabilities into reliable creative workflows. You’ll lead programs across the AI model lifecycle, usage economics, and products like the Weave API. You’ll get close to the architecture, help teams make informed technical tradeoffs, and stay accountable through launch and adoption. You’ll also build AI workflows and automation yourself to help the team move faster.

This full-time role can be based in our New York hub or remotely on the East Coast of the United States. You’ll join a team spread across the United States, Europe, and Tel Aviv, with occasional travel to work alongside Figma Weave partners in Tel Aviv.

What you’ll do at Figma Weave:

  • Lead model lifecycle management across image, video, editing, enhancement, audio/lip-sync, 3D, and vector models, using the existing evaluation process to drive new model integration, launch, updates, and deprecation
  • Make tradeoffs around quality, reliability, latency, cost, and capacity clear to the decision owners
  • Track model limitations, integration issues, and provider dependencies through fixes, rollout, and follow-up
  • Work with Engineering, Partnerships, and Finance on provider agreements, quotas, rate limits, and capacity commitments so Weave can support product growth and launch demand. Bring in Product, Legal, and Security to resolve dependencies
  • Manage AI costs, capacity, and unit economics across 10+ providers and 50+ models. Forecast usage and spend, plan provider capacity for launches, and work with engineers on fallback options
  • Build things that make work less work. Improve process design and build AI workflows and automation that help the team move faster.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic’s Global Safety, Intelligence, and Security (GSIS) team is responsible for protecting our people, facilities, and operations worldwide. The function spans intelligence, executive protection, investigations, travel and event security, security operations, environmental health and safety, and crisis management.

We are seeking a Protective Intelligence Analyst to join our GSIS team. In this role, you will play a critical part in identifying, assessing, and mitigating threats to Anthropic's people, facilities, operations, and reputation through intelligence collection, analysis, and dissemination. You'll have the opportunity to help shape the program from the ground up, establishing workflows, analytical standards, and stakeholder relationships that will scale as Anthropic grows.

This role sits at the intersection of intelligence analysis, behavioral threat assessment, and executive protection. You'll produce actionable intelligence that informs security decisions across the organization and operate across the full intelligence cycle, from collection and processing to analysis, production, and dissemination, in a high-tempo environment where the threat landscape is rapidly evolving. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives on the analytical challenge of connecting disparate data points into a coherent threat picture and translating that picture into clear, actionable guidance for decision-makers.

Important Note: In this position, you may be exposed to graphic and explicit content, including material of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct all-source intelligence collection and analysis to identify, assess and prioritize physical security threats to Anthropic and its personnel
  • Produce clear, well-sourced analytical products, from quick-turn updates to in-depth analytical reports for executive delivery
  • Investigate and triage concerning communications, online threats, and persons of concern using established threat assessment methodologies
  • Apply behavioral threat assessment principles to persons-of-concern cases, analyzing patterns of concerning behavior, indicators of escalation toward violence, and mitigating factors to guide case disposition and ongoing threat management
  • Provide intelligence support for executive protection, travel security, and major events, including pre-travel and event briefs, assessments, and real-time threat monitoring

We specialize in particle and contamination control, visual inspection, and advanced analytical services.  With approximately 30 employees and growing, we are looking for a  Finance & Business Operations Manager  to build and take ownership of our finance function and support the development of our business operations.  This is a hands-on role combining accounting and controlling with systems implementation, process improvement and day-to-day controlling and financial administration. You will work closely with management and colleagues across the company, establishing the financial transparency and processes needed to support our continued growth.

Set up finance systems and processes:  Select, set up, and implement accounting, controlling and reporting systems, integrations, approval workflows and internal controls.

Support international operations:  Coordinate external accounting, tax and payroll providers for future international sites and integrate local financial information into group reporting.

A professional qualification or degree in accounting, finance, business administration or a related field. A recognised Swiss finance and accounting qualification is an advantage.

Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.  We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role  You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame.  This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain.

What You'll Work On

Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in.

Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else.

Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures.

Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate.

Evaluation: held-out sites, night and thermal slices, regression gates. A model that is worse anywhere does not ship.

Training machinery: multi-GPU training, data loaders for multi-sensor clips, experiment tracking and reproducible runs.

Who We're Looking For  A research engineer who has shipped multimodal models, not only published them. You know when an open model is good enough and when to build, you measure on the slice that matters before claiming a number, and you care whether the model works on a real site, not only on a benchmark.

Your Background

4+ years training and fine-tuning large vision or multimodal models, or a PhD plus industry experience.

Strong PyTorch, comfortable with multi-GPU and multi-node training.

Hands-on fine-tuning of vision-language models (instruction tuning, parameter-efficient methods, full fine-tunes).

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

As foundation models move from answering questions to acting over long horizons, memory becomes a central requirement. Systems must decide what is worth keeping and improve from experience. jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Safeguards organization builds the policies, evaluations, and detection and enforcement systems that define and hold the limits on how Claude can be used. Within Safeguards, our Policy, Enforcement, and Threat Intelligence teams work as one org: Policy Design defines what is and isn't allowed across harm areas, Enforcement detects and acts on violations, and Threat Intelligence investigates sophisticated misuse and emerging threats.

That work runs across a lot of teams and moves fast. A single decision can touch model training, detection systems, product launches, legal review, and external communications. As the org's program manager, you'll keep all of it moving: tracking the portfolio across all three teams, running the processes that connect their work to each other and to the rest of the company, and making sure the right people are aligned before decisions land.

Your work will include the operating rhythm (planning, priorities, status, and decision tracking), launch and release readiness across policy, enforcement, and threat intelligence workstreams, and the processes that support how we share our work externally, including blog posts, threat reports, and other publications. You'll work closely with the org's leadership to spot risks early, clear blockers, and keep everyone pointed in the same direction.

This role is a good fit for someone who brings structure to ambiguous, fast-moving work without adding overhead, and who can earn the trust of policy experts, researchers, and engineers alike.

  • Coordinate policy work with partner teams across research, product, engineering, legal, and communications, so dependencies are surfaced early and nothing lands on a partner as a surprise

jobs.title: Research Engineer, AI Monitoring
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data.

When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human. This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design.

The work combines research and production engineering:

  • The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on Claude Code auto mode and Constitutional Classifiers.

  • The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints.

Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you'll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. That moves the hard part of the job towards deciding what to do and in what order. Additionally, organisation, communication, and prioritisation skills matter a great deal as our classifiers sit in the path of many other teams' work.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, train, and evaluate classifiers that detect unsafe agent actions in real time, owning pieces such as prompted models, trained classifiers, or probes on model internals

  • Deploy, tune and operate these classifiers in the critical path of internal agents, RL training, and evaluations, and own their accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and failure behaviour

jobs.title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Test Engineer
jobs.description:
Ubuntu is the most widely used Linux distribution in the world, delivering kernels across a vast matrix of versions, architectures, and configurations – with up to 15 years of security and maintenance commitments for Long Term Support (LTS) releases. Ensuring the quality and reliability of these kernels demands a dedicated, systematic approach to testing at scale.  The Canonical Kernel Team is looking for a Test Engineer to take ownership of our kernel testing strategy and infrastructure. You will design and maintain test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security. You will build and evolve automated test frameworks – including stress testing, fuzzing, code coverage analysis, and regression detection – that not only must remain effective across many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance, but must be able to scale with the high demand for Ubuntu kernels (currently more than 160 under active support).  The successful candidate will bring strong Python skills, familiarity with Linux kernel internals, and experience building test infrastructure that scales. You will work closely with kernel engineers to catch regressions early, validate fixes, and ensure every kernel we ship meets the highest standards of reliability.

Location:  This role will be based remotely in the APAC region, except for Taipei, Taiwan, and Beijing, China, which are office-based locations.  What your day will look like

Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security for Ubuntu Linux kernels

Build and improve automated test infrastructure for continuous kernel quality validation across multiple kernel versions and architectures

Maintain long-lived test suites that evolve alongside Ubuntu’s many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance

Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for continuous kernel quality validation

Conduct performance benchmarking and regression detection across kernel releases

Measure and improve kernel code coverage, identifying gaps in test coverage and creating tests to address them

Execute and analyze stress tests covering CPU scheduling, memory management, I/O subsystems, networking, and filesystem workloads

Develop and maintain fuzzing harnesses to discover kernel vulnerabilities and reliability issues using tools such as syzkaller, Trinity, or custom fuzzers

Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team

Contribute to upstream test suites and testing frameworks

Document test methodologies, results, and coverage gaps

What we are looking for in you

Significant programming experience in Python

Experience with test frameworks such as LTP, kselftest, xfstests, stress-ng, fio, or similar

Experience designing and executing system-level tests: functional, stress, performance, or regression testing

Familiarity with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub CI, or similar)

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Platform Security Engineering (PSE) sits within Data Center Security Engineering (DCSE). As Anthropic expands beyond traditional cloud providers into owned facilities, colocation, and partner sites, we take on the security responsibilities that cloud providers used to abstract away: firmware integrity, boot chain verification, platform trust, and host hardening. PSE exists so that Anthropic can deploy training and inference workloads to any qualified environment with a demonstrable security posture, including the technical controls behind our AI Safety Level commitments.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead a group of platform security engineers covering firmware research, OS and kernel hardening, platform trust integration, and server manageability firmware. You will own the roadmap for this group, grow the team, and be accountable for the security posture of the compute platforms Anthropic runs on: hardware roots of trust, secure and measured boot, attestation, firmware supply chain, and the integrity of the hosts that hold model weights on bare-metal infrastructure.

This is a hands-on management role. You will not write most of the code, but you will review designs, make the final call on hard trade-offs, and be able to reason with your engineers from a silicon root of trust through firmware, bootloader, kernel, and host software. You will partner with infrastructure, fleet, and compute teams inside Anthropic, and with silicon vendors, OEMs, and compute providers outside it.

You will report to the Data Center Security Engineering manager.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and grow the platform security engineering group: hiring, onboarding, development, performance, and prioritization for full-time engineers, and coordination of contractor and vendor engineers working alongside them

  • Own the platform security roadmap and its delivery: hardware root of trust and attestation, secure and measured boot across CPU, BMC, accelerator, and peripheral firmware, OS and kernel hardening, and the host-side pipeline that turns attestation evidence into production gates

  • Own the firmware supply chain posture for the fleet: SBOM and reference integrity manifests, authenticated update, rollback protection, and the vendor relationships needed to get fixes shipped

Samsara  (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US in the following states: Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, and Arkansas.

You want to impact the industries that run our world:  Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

About the Role

We're seeking an exceptional technical accounting leader to establish and scale our technical accounting function as we grow. This is a rare opportunity to define accounting policy and financial reporting standards across a high-growth, dynamic environment, partnering with a world-class team, while ensuring rigorous quarterly, annual, and ad hoc investor reporting as a private company.

Responsibilities

Technical Accounting

  • Develop and maintain U.S. GAAP policies across complex areas, including revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), fixed assets (ASC 360), debt/financing (ASC 470/835), business combinations (ASC 805), equity/stock compensation (ASC 718, ASC 505), and collaborative arrangements (ASC 808)
  • Serve as subject matter expert on complex transactions, including structured financing, equipment financing, and customer contracts
  • Partner with Revenue Accounting on revenue recognition for usage-based, subscription, and enterprise contracts, and evaluate the accounting treatment for collaborative arrangements, including co-development and joint go-to-market deals
  • Assist with lease accounting and capitalization policy for data center, colocation, and equipment arrangements
  • Advise on equity transactions (stock issuances, SAFEs, convertible instruments, stock-based compensation) and strategic investments/joint ventures
  • Draft technical accounting memos for significant transactions and non-standard deal structures
  • Monitor and implement new accounting standards
  • Partner with Legal, Tax, FP&A, Strategic Finance, and other teams on accounting implications of new contracts and transactions
  • Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process for technical accounting areas, including review of complex and judgmental journal entries and account reconciliations

Investor Reporting and Financial Statement Audit

  • Lead quarterly, annual and ad hoc investor financial reporting packages
  • Partner with FP&A, Legal, and Investor Relations to ensure clear, accurate disclosures
  • Support ad hoc reporting tied to fundraising, board reporting, or strategic transactions
  • Lead preparation of annual consolidated financial statements and manage the annual audit process, including coordination with external auditors

SOX & Internal Controls

  • Help lay the foundation for the Company's future SOX program, including initial risk assessment and control design
  • Develop internal control processes to support long-term audit readiness
  • Partner with external auditors on control-related discussions and early readiness efforts
  • Foster awareness of strong internal controls across Accounting, FP&A, and other teams

jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a top-performing Principal Technical Designer to join our design organization remotely within the US or hybrid in our Culver City hub.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

As Principal Technical Designer, you will sit between game designers and the full stack that carries their content from authoring to the player: Tools (the designer interface), Engine (how the game consumes data), and Infrastructure (how data is stored and delivered), and make sure designers are set up to build content quickly, safely, and at scale. You will turn how designers actually work into clear requirements for Tools, and build the templates, data structures, validation, and standards that let great ideas become shipped content without waiting on an engineer. Your hands-on work and expertise will unlock the team of designers to create more compelling content for our players, deliver it much more quickly, and eliminate points of friction throughout the process.

What you will do:

  • Own the content workflow experience for game designers, from first idea through live content, and raise it to a standard where authoring is fast, safe, and a pleasure.
  • Bridge game designers and the full data stack: turn designer pain points into clear, prioritized requirements for Tools, Engine, and Infrastructure, and translate their constraints back into practical guidance.
  • Measure how designers work today (iteration time, hand-offs, engineer-assist requests, content defects) and remove the biggest sources of friction.
  • Partner with Tools, Engine, and Infrastructure to specify authoring tools, data schemas, validation, and delivery, and act as the first and most demanding user during prototyping and rollout.

jobs.description:

Together AI is a research-driven AI infrastructure company building the go-to platform for developers to run, fine-tune, and build on open models. We believe open and transparent AI systems drive innovation and create the best outcomes for society, and we're on a mission to dramatically lower the cost of modern AI systems. Our team has helped ship foundational open-source research like FlashAttention, FlexGen, and RedPajama — and we're building the next generation of AI infrastructure.

We're looking for a hands-on security leader to own infrastructure security.

You'll be the technical owner of how we keep our systems secure, building internal security tooling, deepening our detection and telemetry, and hardening our global infrastructure against threats that range from opportunistic attackers to sophisticated nation-state actors.

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Consumer
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We're a small zero-to-one team at Anthropic building brand new consumer AI products. Our mandate: put the full power of frontier Claude models in people's hands, in products that don't exist yet.

You'd be a founding engineer, and engineers here own products end to end. You won't be handed a spec. You'll come up with the bet, shape a vague idea into the leanest real version one, and ship it. Most zero-to-one bets don't work the first time, so you'll keep pushing new products over the line. If you'd rather have a clear spec and a stable surface, that's a valid preference. It's just not this team.

Claude is already one of the most-used AI products in the world. What we build shapes how millions of people use AI every day. The pace is fast and the products are new. If you love building consumer products from scratch and care about getting the details right, we'd like to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Originate new consumer AI product bets and own them from first idea to launch
  • Spot the gap between what Claude can do and what people actually experience, and bring the bet: what to build, why now, and the cheapest way to test it
  • Take a vague direction and cut it down to the leanest real version one
  • Set technical direction for the products you build
  • Own the quality bar for how the product looks and feels, treating latency, responsiveness, and reliability as first-class concerns
  • Partner with privacy, security, legal, design, platform teams and external partners to find a path to launch
  • Iterate quickly based on user feedback and internal testing
  • Keep pushing new products over the line, since most zero-to-one bets don't work the first time

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience building consumer-facing products, with a strong emphasis on product quality and user experience
  • Experience taking a consumer product from nothing to real users
  • Proficiency in React, Next.js, and TypeScript
  • Backend experience with Node.js

Preferred qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience building consumer-facing products, with a strong emphasis on product quality and user experience
  • Experience founding a company, being on a founding team, or being an early engineer on a new consumer product
  • Experience with products that have real-time or streaming interactions (chat interfaces, live updates)

jobs.title: External Affairs, Southeast Asia

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Singapore-based Public Policy expert to lead Anthropic’s policy engagement in Singapore and across the region. In this role, you will advance practical AI governance and support Anthropic’s commercial expansion by building strategic relationships with Southeast Asian government authorities, developing substantive policy positions and papers, and engaging in regular outreach to drive progress in AI policy and AI safety. You will draw upon established relationships with key policymakers and their staff to shape how the region approaches AI regulation and safety during a critical period of governance development.

As part of this role, you will collaborate with a dynamic, geographically distributed policy team on a variety of projects, including analyzing policy proposals, drafting submissions to requests for public comment, planning and executing policy campaigns in Southeast Asia, and providing policy advice to technical colleagues. This is a foundational hire — you will be building Anthropic’s policy presence in Singapore and the region from the ground up.

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct comprehensive mapping of key Southeast Asian AI policy stakeholders and build strategic relationships with government and regional multilateral officials, think tank researchers, and civil society leaders
  • Brief a diverse set of policy and research actors looking to better understand AI safety and AI policy opportunities in the Southeast Asia context
  • Convene diverse stakeholders and speak at policy events such as research announcements, discussion panels, or workshops on AI safety topics
  • Analyze emerging legislation and develop Anthropic’s engagement strategy, including preparing substantive policy submissions and response documents
  • Support senior colleagues in external engagements by preparing meeting briefs and taking action on follow-up requests

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic funds delivery partners to help customers adopt Claude, through assessments, workshops, proofs of concept, and full delivery engagements. Our partner request process is the front door for all of it: an account executive (AE) requests partner support, and the request is checked against program rules and matched to a partner.

Commercial is the program's highest-volume segment, and the one where a quick introduction and the right match matter most. Automation now drafts the first match and the introduction, and a vendor delivery team handles day-to-day follow-up and tracker updates. What's left is the work that needs a person sellers trust.

You'll be the one Activations contact for US Commercial sellers once a request is in, from submission to a partner on a signed statement of work (SOW). Partner Sales Managers (PSMs) attach the partner and own the opportunity, and at their volume they move on to the next deal. You'll own the follow-through: matching and re-matching, getting AE and customer introductions to happen, handling exception requests, and working the special cases that don't fit the standard path. Decision rights are clear: the program lead sets program rules, targets, and exception policy; you apply them on Commercial requests, decide what the rules already cover, and bring the rest with a recommendation.

We're looking for a partner seller or channel operator whom sellers and partners trust, who is comfortable owning a high-volume book, and who keeps following up until each request is closed. Success in this role comes down to three things: how quickly Commercial requests move from AE introduction to customer introduction and on to a signed SOW, whether sellers know exactly who to go to and get a straight answer, and whether exceptions are handled the same way every time.

Key responsibilities

  • Serve as the single point of contact for the AE, the PSM, and the partner on every US Commercial request, from submission to confirmed SOW, so sellers deal with one person instead of several

About the role

Anthropic's products are growing fast in reach and complexity. Every new model, product, and channel brings problems no one predicted. We want to catch each issue as early as possible, get customers unblocked fast, and fix the root cause. The best experience is one where a customer never has to ask for help.

We are building a Support Technology engineering team to solve what stands between a customer and Claude, whether they want to use it but can't or are unhappy with their experience. That covers individual users, businesses, and customers who reach Claude through partners.

Our goal is a better product experience for everyone who uses Claude. We make it easy for customers to get help and talk to us, through Claude itself and via human specialists with the tools to solve their problems. We also determine why they needed help and fix the cause in the product.

Billing is a good example. When a charge is confusing, a payment fails, or a plan doesn't unlock, a customer should be able to reach us and get it resolved in one conversation. Then we want to learn why it happened and change the product, whether that's the subscription flow, the payment error, or the invoice, so the next customer never has to ask.

As one of the team's early engineers, you will set the technical direction and build the core systems behind this work. We expect Claude to handle more of each case over time, from diagnosing an issue to resolving it to flagging the product fix behind it. Success means customers run into fewer problems, get them truly solved when they do, and are happy with the help they receive, whether it comes from Claude or a person.

This is a hands-on role with high leverage. You will write a lot of code and lead across teams, since many fixes belong to other product teams. You will partner with our Product Manager, the Product Support team, and product engineering teams such as Billing Platform.

Key responsibilities

  • Improve the product experience at the root: Build agents that spot where customers keep getting stuck and find the root cause, then ship the fix or drive it with the owning team until customers stop running into the problem
